jobs.descriptionHtml:

* wanita/laki laki maximal 40 tahun
* Memiliki pengalaman sebagai **Furniture Designer** menjadi nilai tambah.

* Membuat gambar kerja yang dapat digunakan oleh tim produksi.
* Melakukan koordinasi dengan tim produksi untuk memastikan desain dapat diproduksi sesuai spesifikasi.
* Memahami teknis teknis furniture
* Membuat prototype dan melakukan evaluasi terhadap fungsi, estetika, kenyamanan, serta kekuatan produk.
* Membantu menghitung atau menyesuaikan desain dengan **efisiensi material dan biaya produksi**.
* Memastikan desain sesuai standar kualitas dan karakter brand perusahaan.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bekasi

jobs.title: Substation/Receiving Station Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Substation/Receiving Station Engineer

**Location:** Pasuruan, East Java  
**Job Type:** Full-time

Job Description

We are seeking a qualified and experienced Substation/Receiving Station Engineer to support electrical infrastructure projects involving substations with voltage levels of 150 kV or higher.

The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting substation engineering activities, overseeing electrical installations and testing, reviewing technical drawings, and coordinating with PLN to ensure project execution meets technical specifications and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

* Supervise and monitor substation and receiving station installation activities.
* Oversee transformer installation and high-voltage testing activities.
* Understand and monitor protection relay systems and grid synchronization processes.
* Review and interpret primary and secondary electrical engineering drawings.
* Perform technical assessments and troubleshooting of electrical equipment and systems.
* Coordinate with PLN regarding technical matters and project implementation.
* Identify, analyze, and resolve technical problems during field operations.
* Support emergency handling and troubleshooting activities at project sites.
* Ensure engineering work complies with applicable technical standards and project specifications.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree (S1) in Electrical Engineering.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in substation projects involving 150 kV or higher voltage levels.
* Strong knowledge of transformer installation, high-voltage testing, protection relay systems, and grid synchronization.
* Proficient in reading and reviewing primary and secondary electrical drawings.
* Proficient in CAD software.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* Previous experience coordinating with PLN.
* Strong technical analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Able to work independently and handle emergency situations in the field.
* Willing to work on-site and travel to project locations when required.
* Must possess a personal work laptop.

Application Requirements

Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their updated CV, including relevant substation project experience and technical qualifications.

Application Question(s):

* Apakah Anda memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun dalam proyek Substation/Receiving Station dengan tegangan 150 kV atau lebih tinggi?
* Apakah Anda memiliki pengalaman dalam instalasi transformator, High Voltage Testing, dan pengujian Protection Relay?
* Apakah Anda mampu membaca dan meninjau gambar teknik kelistrikan primer dan sekunder serta mahir menggunakan software CAD?
* Apakah Anda fasih berbahasa Inggris dan memiliki pengalaman berkoordinasi langsung dengan PLN terkait proyek kelistrikan?
* Apakah Anda bersedia ditempatkan di Pasuruan, Jawa Timur, memiliki laptop pribadi, dan siap bekerja langsung di lapangan?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: QUANTITY SURVEYOR / ESTIMATOR
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**QUANTITY SURVEYOR / ESTIMATOR**
  
  
Kami mencari kandidat yang memiliki pengalaman langsung dalam menyusun Rencana Anggaran Biaya (RAB), khususnya untuk pembangunan rumah tinggal dan renovasi rumah, serta memahami karakteristik biaya dan metode pelaksanaan pekerjaan konstruksi skala kecil hingga menengah.
  
  
Kualifikasi:

* Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Teknik Sipil atau bidang terkait.
* Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai QS, Estimator, atau posisi sejenis di bidang konstruksi.
* Wajib memiliki pengalaman langsung menyusun RAB pembangunan rumah tinggal dan/atau renovasi rumah.
* Mampu membaca gambar kerja dan melakukan perhitungan volume (quantity take-off) secara mandiri untuk pekerjaan struktur, arsitektur, finishing, elektrikal, dan plumbing.
* Memahami analisis harga satuan pekerjaan, termasuk harga material, upah tenaga kerja, produktivitas tukang, dan metode pelaksanaan.
* Mampu menyusun estimasi biaya yang realistis dan kompetitif berdasarkan spesifikasi, volume pekerjaan, serta kondisi lapangan.
* Memahami karakteristik pekerjaan renovasi, termasuk pembongkaran, perbaikan bangunan eksisting, dan pekerjaan tambah-kurang.
* Memiliki pengalaman menghitung RAB untuk ruko, fit-out tenant, restoran, atau bangunan komersial skala kecil hingga menengah.
* Mahir menggunakan Microsoft Excel untuk penyusunan RAB dan analisis biaya, serta mampu membaca gambar menggunakan AutoCAD atau software sejenis.
* Bersedia melakukan survei lapangan dan berkoordinasi dengan tim proyek, purchasing, vendor, serta subkontraktor.
* Teliti, analitis, komunikatif, dan mampu bekerja dengan target waktu.

  
Lamaran dapat dikirimkan melalui email ke **elkon.hrd@gmail.com** dengan subject: **Lamaran Pekerjaan - Nama Lengkap - Posisi yang ingin dilamar**

jobs.title: Product Manager - (Infrastructure & System Administration Efficiency for Spectrum Power 7)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.**

**You'll make an impact by**

* Defining and driving the infrastructure and system administration product strategy and roadmap for Spectrum Power 7 in alignment with market needs and business priorities
* Translating complex infrastructure, hardware, and customer requirements into clear product requirements, roadmap decisions, and value-driven prioritization
* Driving the efficiency of all system administration tasks, including automated software deployment, hardening, certificate handling, and cybersecurity settings
* Partnering closely with R&D, software architects, and regional project teams to ensure organizational alignment and the successful introduction of modern platforms like OpenShift
* Leading the strategic migration planning from legacy environments (e.g., KVM) to modern container orchestration (OpenShift Virtualization), evaluating business cases and cost implications
* Standardizing network configurations and segmentation across the portfolio, ensuring strict alignment with cybersecurity standards like IEC 62443
* Representing the Spectrum Power 7 infrastructure perspective in customer discussions, tenders, audits, and technical assessments
* Aligning product management, engineering, and business stakeholders across functions to ensure execution transparency and strategic consistency
* Monitoring infrastructure trends, virtualization developments, and competitive trends relevant to energy automation and critical infrastructure software

**This is how you'll win us over:**

* **Education:** You hold a university degree in computer science, electrical engineering, software engineering, or a related field
* **Experience & Skills:** Minimum 5 years of experience in product management, technical project management, or infrastructure engineering, with a proven ability to drive strategic topics
* **Experience & Skills:** You have strong expertise in infrastructure requirements and know how to translate technical needs into product strategy and customer value
* **Experience & Skills:** You have hands-on familiarity with IT infrastructure trends, specifically Virtualization (KVM), Container Orchestration (OpenShift/Kubernetes), and automated deployment
* **Experience & Skills:** You bring solid domain knowledge in SCADA, EMS, DMS, utility markets, and critical infrastructure environments
* **Experience & Skills:** You have a deep understanding of cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443), hardening procedures, and certificate management
* **Ways of working:** You combine strategic thinking with a structured, self-driven, and collaborative way of working, and you are confident engaging with both technical and business stakeholders
* **Languages:** You communicate fluently in English

**In return, we offer you:**

* Attractive compensation and benefits
* Flexible working arrangement
* Values-driven work culture with inclusive workplace policies and practices that prioritize diversity and inclusion
* Endless possibilities and opportunities for progression and learning

**Recruitment Process:**

* CV Screening
* A session with our recruiter to understand your motivation & your past experiences
* 1-3 Business Interviews
* Offer Stage
* Medical test

**Transform The Everyday with Us!**

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better everyday with us.

**Public Notice: Recruitment Fraud**

We wish to caution jobseekers that Siemens, as a policy, does not authorize external parties/agents to conduct employment drives or extend Offers of Employment on our behalf. We do not ask for bank details, payment of any kind nor personal financial information in return for assurance of employment. Please visit our job portal for all Siemens job openings, and apply via the portal.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Posting Date2026.10.29

Job TypeRegular

TeamProduct Management

Location

BSD City, Indonesia

About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region.

**Job Description**
===================

*Job ID: MJ000427*

  
  

We seek a talented and experienced Senior Product Manager with strong expertise in customer-facing mobile Apps and Desktop web platforms to join our dynamic team. Our Product Management team plays a vital role in transforming ideas into innovative products that address user experience needs and elevate the Traveloka experience. You will also be driving the development and implementation of critical technical products that enhance our platform's capabilities and help users discover and fulfill their travel inspiration and needs.

* Contribute to the technical product vision and strategy across customer-facing Apps and Desktop product lines within Demand Products.
* Develops and maintains detailed product roadmaps, incorporating technical input and aligning with business priorities, focusing on specific phases like ideation or post-launch optimization.
* Guides and mentors junior team members, fostering technical literacy and collaboration with engineering teams.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define technical requirements, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance of customer-facing platforms across Apps and Desktop.
* Conduct in-depth market research and competitive analysis on customer-facing app and web experiences, industry UX trends, and digital product benchmarks to identify opportunities for innovation.
* Design, run, and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to validate product hypotheses and drive iterative improvements across Apps and Desktop.
* Work with UX/UI designers and data scientists to support cohesive product strategies across platforms.
* Help prioritize features and manage backlog with oversight from senior managers.
* Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for product performance and identify areas for technical improvement.
* Stay informed on industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to the product line.
  

  

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field from a reputable university.
* Minimum 8 years of product management experience, with at least 3 years managing customer-facing mobile Apps and/or Desktop web products.
* Experience in travel, e-commerce, or other high-traffic consumer app environments.
* Proven experience handling customer-facing Apps and Desktop platforms, with strong understanding of cross-platform user experience, app performance, and API-driven product development.
* Experience designing and running A/B tests or other experimentation methods to inform product decisions.
* Strong understanding of software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum).
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to think strategically.
* Proven track record of successful product launches and iterations.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in data-driven decision-making.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Designation

Software Engineer-2

Job Title

Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java]

Job Description

We are looking for Software Engineer (Backend). As a software engineer, you'll be the brain behind crafting, developing, testing, going live, and maintaining the system. You are passionate in understanding the business context for features built to drive better customer experience and adoption.

  
  

**About E-Money**

As part of Flip's Consumer Solutions group, you will be the go-to person to work on our e-money part, mainly the Flip Saldo feature. You will be working with a cross-functional team to answer various business questions e.g. increasing the number of transacting users with Flip Saldo. You will be utilizing different tech stacks for various use cases, such as Java (for E-Money core system), Go (cash top-up feature in one of the top Indonesian retailers), and PHP to a certain use case (integration with monolithic system).

  
  

**About Flip**

Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app.

  
  

After nine years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.

  
  

At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits.

  
  
  

**What you'll do**

* Work cross-functionally with the Product, Design, Operations, and Backend teams across the squads to ship world-class products and features.
* Write code that's clear, concise, performant, tested, and easily understood by others.
* Partner with the product management team to execute the feature roadmap.
* Work with the overall backend teams to execute the engineering roadmap.
* Help debug production issues across services and levels of the stack.
  

  

**What you'll need**

* Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions.
* Experience working with payment and/or accounting system is preferrable.
* Knowledge and experience in Java and Go, PHP Yii2 experience is a plus.
* Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency system is a plus.
* Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code.
* Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability.
* Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Designation

Software Engineer-1

Job Title

Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core

Job Description

We’re hiring **Junior Software Engineers (Backend)** to join the **Core Payment Platform team** at Flip. If you’re passionate about building reliable systems, eager to learn, and excited to work on products that impact millions of Indonesians, this is your chance.

  
  

**About Core Payment Platform**

As part of the Payment Platform group, our team builds and maintains the critical services that power Flip’s ecosystem. We run over 20 projects that are essential for all business verticals, from money transfers to financial products. Our current mission is to break down Flip’s monolith service and set new engineering standards across the company. This is a rare opportunity to work on systems at scale, while learning modern backend practices in a supportive environment. We primarily use **Go** for our backend services, with **PostgreSQL** and **Redis** as our main data stores. Depending on the project, we use a mix of in-house tools and **Google Cloud Platform** services.

  
  

**About Flip**

Flip was founded in 2015 by three friends from Universitas Indonesia — Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar — with the goal of making money transfers fairer for Indonesians. Today, millions of individuals and businesses trust Flip to send trillions of rupiah across banks every year.

We’re backed by leading investors such as **Sequoia India, Insight Partners, and Insignia**, and our mission is simple: **to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.**

At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits.

  
  

**What you’ll do**

* Work with senior engineers to build and maintain backend services used across Flip’s ecosystem.
* Write clear, tested, and efficient code, mainly in Go.
* Review and learn from code written by peers and provide constructive feedback.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver reliable features.
* Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues under guidance.
  

  

**What you’ll need**

* Basic programming experience in any backend language (Go experience is a strong plus).
* Understanding of core computer science concepts: data structures, algorithms, OOP, and clean code principles.
* Willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly.
* Good problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team.
* Alignment with Flip’s values of fairness, respect, and continuous learning.
  

  

**Why join Flip?**

* Learn directly from experienced engineers working on large-scale systems.
* Be part of a mission-driven company making finance fairer in Indonesia.
* Grow your career in a supportive and collaborative environment.
* Enjoy fair rewards, clear goals, and recognition for your contributions.

We’re backed by leading investors such as **Sequoia India, Insight Partners, and Insignia**, and our mission is simple: **to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.** At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you’ll do** * Work with senior engineers to build and maintain backend services used across Flip’s ecosystem. * Write clear, tested, and efficient code, mainly in Go. * Review and learn from code written by peers and provide constructive feedback. * Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver reliable features. * Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues under guidance. **What you’ll need** * Basic programming experience in any backend language (Go experience is a strong plus). * Understanding of core computer science concepts: data structures, algorithms, OOP, and clean code principles. * Willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly. * Good problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team. * Alignment with Flip’s values of fairness, respect, and continuous learning. **Why join Flip?** * Learn directly from experienced engineers working on large-scale systems. * Be part of a mission-driven company making finance fairer in Indonesia. * Grow your career in a supportive and collaborative environment. * Enjoy fair rewards, clear goals, and recognition for your contributions.

jobs.title: Lead (Backend) Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**About the GEO Team**
----------------------

GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. The GEO team builds products that help multi-location brands understand and improve how they are represented, cited, and recommended across AI-powered search and answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

We are building backend capabilities that collect and analyse signals from rapidly evolving AI platforms, measure brand visibility, and turn complex data into actionable recommendations for our customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

As Backend Engineering Lead for Uberall’s GEO team, you will take on a **hybrid role that combines people management with hands-on engineering**. You will be responsible for the growth and effectiveness of the team, and you will also write code, review pull requests, and shape technical designs alongside them. On this team, leads stay close to the work. Hands-on contribution is a core part of the role, not something you step back from as the team grows.

You will shape the architecture behind our AI-search products, lead the delivery of new capabilities, and help the team navigate a fast-moving and technically ambiguous domain. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders, you will translate customer needs and emerging developments in generative AI into reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend solutions.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

### **People leadership**

* Lead and develop the GEO backend team. This covers hiring, regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and supporting each engineer’s growth.
* Own delivery with Product. Shape priorities, make sure commitments are realistic, and remove blockers so the team ships steadily.
* Build the engineering culture of the team: shared standards, constructive code reviews, knowledge sharing, and collective ownership of quality.

### **Hands-on engineering**

* Contribute regularly to design, code, and reviews as an active member of the team, not only as a reviewer or approver.
* Guide the design and operation of backend systems that integrate with LLMs and AI-powered search platforms.
* Establish robust approaches for evaluating the quality and consistency of AI-generated results.
* Ensure that LLM-enabled capabilities are observable, testable, cost-efficient, and resilient to changing models and external providers.
* Help the team manage the particular challenges of generative AI systems, including non-deterministic behaviour, latency, rate limits, data quality, and graceful degradation.
* Stay informed about relevant developments in LLMs and AI search, assessing them pragmatically rather than adopting technology for its own sake.

**Your Profile**
----------------

### **Must have**

* Proven experience leading an engineering team with genuine people responsibility (hiring, 1:1s, performance, and delivery) while continuing to contribute code and technical design.
* Motivation to stay hands-on as a lead, balancing management responsibilities with regular engineering work.
* Strong proficiency in Kotlin or Groovy; proven coding skills in other JVM languages (such as Java or Scala) are a plus.
* Solid experience with our core stack and architecture: Spring Boot, Hibernate, JUnit, MySQL, Elasticsearch, Docker, AWS and OpenAPI, applied within microservice and event-driven systems.
* Hands-on experience building or operating production systems that use LLMs, generative AI, or AI-powered external services.
* An understanding of how to evaluate and monitor LLM-enabled features beyond traditional deterministic testing.
* Experience designing reliable integrations with third-party APIs and managing concerns such as cost, latency, rate limits, observability, and provider failure.
* The ability to distinguish between an effective AI use case and one better solved with conventional software.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with Python and LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.
* Experience with prompt management, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, or LLM evaluation frameworks.

No experience training foundation models is required; this is a backend engineering and engineering leadership role.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
#### **Build the backbone of BYD's supply chain digital ecosystem — architect high-performance backend systems powering operations across Indonesia and beyond.**

#### **Location: Subang, Indonesia**

### **Job Responsibilities**

* Oversee the back-end technical system planning, architecture design and continuous iteration of the supply chain business line, to guarantee the forward-looking design, stability and scalability of the systems.
* Take the lead in major business projects and core system reconstruction, and resolve technical challenges including high concurrency, high availability and data consistency.
* Formulate and drive the implementation of development specifications, quality standards and performance baselines for the team.
* Act as the technical lead, take charge of core talent cultivation and echelon building, and conduct critical technical decision-making and technical reviews.
* Gain an in-depth understanding of business, participate in product and business planning, and translate complex business requirements into efficient and implementable technical solutions.
* Keep track of industry technical trends and formulate the evolution roadmap of the team's technology stack.

### **Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or above; majors related to Computer Science such as Software Engineering, Network Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Digital Media Technology and Electronic Information are preferred.
* Solid English skills in reading, writing and communication; proficiency in an additional foreign language is a plus.
* No less than 5 years of back-end development experience with proven experience in developing large-scale distributed systems.
* Solid foundational knowledge of Java, proficient in IO, multithreading, collections and mainstream basic frameworks, in-depth research on underlying principles, and familiar with the internal operating mechanism of JVM.
* Skilled in mainstream development frameworks including Spring Boot and Spring Cloud.
* Experienced with message queues (Kafka), distributed cache, ElasticSearch and other middleware technologies.
* Familiar with relational databases (Oracle) and NoSQL databases, capable of designing heterogeneous data systems.

PT BYD Auto Indonesia **does not charge any fees** at any stage of the recruitment process. This includes, but is not limited to, application fees, testing fees, interview fees, medical examination (MCU) fees, processing fees, travel expenses, or any other recruitment-related costs.

Please remain vigilant against fraudulent recruitment activities carried out in the name of PT BYD Auto Indonesia. All official recruitment communications will only be conducted through our authorized corporate channels.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact.

Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.

Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to build the technology that helps freight forwarders protect margin, improve operational efficiency, and differentiate their offering.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

As our Backend Engineer, you will be reporting directly to our Engineering Manager and will work closely with our Product team to develop new products, scale existing ones and manage deployments and architecture. You won't just take tickets here.

You'll dig into how the system actually works, ask why before how, and chase a problem past the surface to the real cause. Curiosity isn't a nice-to-have on this team, it's how we build.

### **WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**

* Design, build and maintain APIs, services and systems and debug production issues across multiple levels of the stack.
* Collaborate closely with our Business, Product and Data Science teams to understand and solve customer pain points at scale.
* Design, Develop, Implement and Deploy enterprise level, high availability web application platforms, with support from the design team at Portcast.
* Create a technology infrastructure that functions well at scale. You will design and improve the system architecture.
* Own end-to-end the design AND implementation of how our product handles real-time data at scale, from event ingestion across dozens of carrier sources, through data normalization, through ML-powered risk and ETA models, to the user-visible recommendations our enterprise customers act on.
* Build features customers actually use, harden internal tooling the team relies on, and create the alerting and monitoring surfaces that catch issues before customers do. You're a builder first, with the judgment to know what's worth building.
* Make architecture trade-offs explicit and defensible.
* Instrument what you build, find real bottlenecks, and pick fixes that survive the next 10× of growth, not just the next sprint. You measure before you optimize, and your numbers are reproducible.

### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent work experience in the field.
* Work Experience: Minimum 5+ years of experience in a technical role designing, developing and releasing technical solutions and building production systems.
* Curious by Default: You dig deeper instead of following instructions to the letter. When something in the system surprises you, you chase the why, not just the fix. You treat every layer of the stack as something worth understanding, and you ask the good questions early.
* System Architecture: You understand how parts of a system fit together and have a strong background in building scalable products or systems. You are comfortable in dealing with lots of moving pieces/data sources and possess meticulous attention to detail. You are quick to generate ideas and give suggestions on how to improve the tech stack and feature developments.
* First Principles Thinker: When you explain a past decision, the trade-offs come out before the tools. You name the constraint, the alternatives you considered, and why you picked what you picked. You don't reach for a new framework when a tighter use of an existing tool would do the job.
* You use AI tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) where they make you faster, and you know exactly where they fall short. You read what they produce, you don't just paste it. You can defend a code path the AI suggested, or override it with reasoning the AI couldn't have known. You flag AI-assisted decisions in code review and submissions without being asked. We treat AI as a tool that makes good thinking faster, not a shortcut around thinking.
* Team Player: You have experience working in a diverse, dynamic and cross-cultural team. This role is an opportunity to drive engineering excellence within the team and participate in key architectural discussions. You are a hands-on goal-orientated engineer who works according to milestones and software guidelines, following agile principles.
* Empathetic Communicator: You can communicate nuanced ideas clearly, from real-time remote brainstorming to explaining a technical decision in writing. You may be opinionated, but in disagreements you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and can compromise when needed.
* You've either been an early engineering hire at a startup where you took a technical product from scratch to scale, OR you've owned real system design at a FAANG-tier engineering org, defended architectural decisions in actual design reviews, not just contributed to someone else's blueprint. Either path counts! We'd love to hear the learnings and the trade-offs you'd make differently today.
* Tech Stack: Ideally you are proficient with Python-based backend programming, web frameworks like Flask, Amazon Web Services. You are able to design RESTful APIs and are aware of best practices. Experience with Docker, Git, Elasticsearch, Spark, CI/CD is a plus. The specific stack matters less than how you reason about it. Strong engineers in any stack pick ours up quickly.

### **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels innovation and keeps us curious.
* Tech-first team: You’ll work with like-minded individuals who share a passion for solving difficult problems using technology.
* Accelerated growth: Compress the learning curve in a couple of years by owning the web app from day one as your own baby. We are building our company to be the next B2B market leader in predictive global supply chains and you’ll be a major part of our story.
* Impact you can see: With a lean structure, your work is effective from the start. You’ll see the results of your ideas and decisions directly moving the business forward.

### **Our CORE Values Guide Everything We Do:**

* Curiosity: We read the code before we trust it. We dig into why a system behaves the way it does, not just how to make the error go away.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait for a ticket to fix what's broken, and we stay on a problem until it's actually solved in production.
* Raising the bar: We do not settle for code that only works locally or solves the immediate request. We aim for backend systems that are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and easy for the team to reason about.
* Effectiveness: We focus on engineering work that creates real product and customer impact. We prioritize the right problems, make practical trade-offs, and ship solutions that improve outcomes, not just output.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Company Description**

GudangAda is a leading B2B marketplace platform with USD 120+ million raised from Sequoia Capital, Alpha JWC, Asia Partner, and Falcon Edge. We focus on addressing the underserved needs of millions of traditional retailers in Indonesia, a segment that faces challenges including limited product variety, uncompetitive wholesale prices, lack of access to producers’ promotional support, and lack of reliable and cost-effective delivery services.

 **Job Description**

Our Tech & Product team members hail from the top company working experiences such as Facebook, Google, Amazon, Uber, Twitter, and Traveloka.

Responsibilities:

* You'll brainstorm with Product Managers, Designers, and Frontend Engineers on your team to conceptualize and build new features for GudangAda large (and growing!) user base.
* You’ll produce high-quality results by contributing heavily to team projects that have a significant impact on the business.
* You’ll actively own team features or systems and define their long-term health, while also improving the health of surrounding systems.
* You'll assist our skilled support team and operations team in triaging and resolving production issues.
* You'll mentor other engineers and deeply review code.
* You’ll improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes

  
**Qualifications**

We are looking for someone with:

* Deep passion for software engineering with an excellent understanding of software engineering concepts, design patterns, and algorithms.
* You can contribute to technical architecture discussions and help drive technical decisions within your team.
* You write understandable, testable code with an eye towards maintainability.
* You are a strong communicator. Explaining complex technical concepts to designers, support, and other engineers is no problem for you.
* You possess strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, programming languages, distributed systems, and information retrieval.
* You have **completed** a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent training, fellowship, or work experience.

  
**Additional Information**

What will you get on working at GudangAda?

* Competitive salary
* Learning experience
* Personal Growth
* Impact at scale
* Mentorship from a world-class team

jobs.title: SPORT ANALYST INTERNATIONAL
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Analis Sepak Bola lnternasional**

Bertanggung jawab menyajikan analisis pertandingan dan kompetisi berbasis data serta sumber tepercaya sebagai bahan editorial untuk preview, prediksi, dan liputan sepak bola.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

* Menganalisis performa terkini tim dan pemain dengan mempertimbangkan hasil, konsistensi, produktivitas, serta konteks pertandingan.
* Mengkaji pendekatan taktik, kekuatan dan kelemahan, kemungkinan susunan pemain, absensi, kondisi kandang/tandang, serta faktor teknis lain yang relevan.
* Menganalisis rekor pertemuan, jadwal, kondisi kompetisi, dan data pendukung lain tanpa mengabaikan keterbatasan atau konteks datanya.
* Menyusun preview dan prediksi pertandingan, termasuk alasan yang mendasari prediksi; membedakan fakta, interpretasi, dan opini dengan jelas.
* Membuat brief analisis yang ringkas, akurat, mudah dipahami, dan dapat digunakan Editor sebagai bahan pengembangan artikel.
* Memantau berita dan perkembangan yang berdampak pada analisis, serta memperbarui brief bila terdapat perubahan penting.
* Mencantumkan sumber untuk data dan klaim, memeriksa keandalan sumber, dan tidak menyajikan spekulasi sebagai fakta.
* Berkolaborasi dengan Editor untuk memastikan sudut analisis sesuai kebutuhan pembaca dan rencana editorial.

**Kualifikasi**

* Memiliki pengetahuan mendalam tentang sepak bola Indonesia, Vietnam, dan internasional serta kompetisi, klub, pemain, dan taktik.
* Mampu menganalisis performa, taktik, rekor pertemuan, dan faktor teknis; mampu menjelaskan kesimpulan secara logis dan terstruktur.
* Terampil melakukan riset dari beberapa sumber tepercaya dan memeriksa konsistensi data sebelum digunakan.
* Mampu menulis dalam bahasa Indonesia dengan jelas; mampu membaca sumber berbahasa Inggris menjadi nilai tambah.
* Teliti, kritis, memenuhi tenggat, dan terbuka terhadap evaluasi hasil prediksi maupun kualitas analisis.
* Nilai tambah: pengalaman membuat preview/prediksi, menggunakan data statistik sepak bola, atau bekerja dengan media olahraga.
* Perlu dicatat, khususnya, bahwa para editor tidak diperbolehkan menggunakan kecerdasan buatan (AI) untuk menulis artikel.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Jakarta Raya

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Requirements :**

* Pendidikan minimal S1 jurusan Teknik informatika dan bidang terkait lainnya
* Minimal 2 tahun di bidang Data Engineering / Database Developer
* Mampu memahami kebutuhan bisnis & mentranslasikannya ke kebutuhan data
* Terbiasa bekerja dengan dataset besar dan kompleks
* Paham konsep data quality, data validation, dan error handling
* Pernah menangani **end-to-end ETL** (dari extract di source → transform → load ke DW)
* Detail-oriented, disiplin dokumentasi (ETL job, data lineage)
* Problem solving & troubleshooting database

**Responsibility :**

* Pengalaman query kompleks & optimasi (Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL). *Familiar dengan indexing, partitioning, dan performance tuning.*
* Membangun pipeline *ETL/ELT* untuk memindahkan data antar database.
* Familiar dengan tools ETL/ELT (Apache Airflow, Talend, Pentaho, dbt, SSIS).
* Paham konsep *CDC (Change Data Capture), batch vs streaming.*
* *Python (wajib, untuk scripting ETL & integrasi).*
* Pengalaman desain data warehouse berbasis *PostgreSQL.*
* Paham konsep OLTP vs OLAP. Paham data modeling *(star schema, snowflake schema).*
* Familiar dengan koneksi antar *DB (ODBC, JDBC).*
* Pengalaman dengan API / message queue (Kafka, RabbitMQ) nilai plus.
* Pengalaman dengan *cloud platform (AWS RDS/Redshift, GCP BigQuery, Azure Synapse).*
* CI/CD pipeline untuk data (Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI).
* *Docker / Kubernetes untuk deployment data pipeline.*

**Output :**

* Pipeline data otomatis (scheduler)
* Konsolidasi data dari Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server ke PostgreSQL
* Dokumentasi lengkap (job list, mapping source → target
* Monitoring & alerting untuk job ETL
* Data warehouse siap dipakai tim BI / Data Analyst.

Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu, Kontrak

Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Wholesale KYC Operations - Middle Office - Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Are you a detail-oriented professional with a passion for Know Your Client (KYC)? We are seeking a highly motivated individual who will play a crucial part in supporting the firm's Wholesale KYC Operations (WKO). As a dynamic and driven professional, you will play a pivotal role in the team where you will have an opportunity to elevate your career to the next level.

As an Analyst within the Wholesale KYC Operations (WKO) Banking Middle Office team in the Corporate & Investment Bank, you will play a critical role in managing the Front Office relationship for business requests in KYC Onboarding, Remediation, and Renewals. You will facilitate the end-to-end client onboarding process, ensuring all due diligence documentation is sourced and delivered to the KYC Production team for incorporation into the KYC platform. You will collaborate closely with Bankers, Operations, Credit, Legal, and Compliance to provide efficient and timely onboarding of new and existing client relationships, ensuring compliance with regulations and protecting the bank's reputation and financial assets.

**Job responsibilities**

* Manage new business requests received from the Front Office and facilitate the KYC process end-to-end.
* Act as an SME and Due Diligence expert to guide clients through KYC requirements and document variations.
* Conduct in-depth analysis on client ownership structures using publicly available sources and client documentation, seeking additional confirmation or approvals as required.
* Work closely with the Front Office and, when necessary, directly with clients to obtain all supporting evidence for full KYC due diligence.
* Follow up with KYC production teams to ensure onboarding is completed within agreed timeframes.
* Liaise regularly with the business for workload planning, reviewing key onboardings, and prioritizing open requests.
* Interact frequently with key stakeholders such as Legal, Compliance, Credit, and Operations to develop strong partnerships, eliminate roadblocks, and ensure continuity of information flow.
* Assist Relationship Managers with overnight screening, client exits, and other KYC-related tasks as required.
* Manage personal workload and priority items, ensuring timely escalation of key risks/issues to management.
* Stay informed of changes to processes, procedures, and regulatory requirements, maintaining open dialogue with regional colleagues.
Identify and execute process improvements, providing guidance and support on key process and technology initiatives.  

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
* At least 1 year of relevant experience in KYC, Client Onboarding, Audit, Control, Risk, AML, or Research functions.
* Knowledge of multiple client types (e.g., Corporates, SPV, Trust, FIs).• Understanding of the financial industry with expertise in various lines of business, including Corporate Investment Banking.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong time management, organizational, and relationship-building skills.
* Client-focused with a strong controls mindset and commitment to quality.
* Experience adhering to controls and compliance standards.
* Ability to quickly grasp and learn new concepts and procedures.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* At least 1 year of relevant experience in KYC, Client Onboarding, Audit, Control, Risk, AML, or Research functions, preferably within the banking industry.
* Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.

**ABOUT US**
  
  
J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

jobs.title: Assistant Director of Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Additional Information**  
**Job Number**26142212  
**Job Category**Finance & Accounting  
**Location**Jalan Jenderal Sudirman, Kav 18 - 20, Jakarta Jakar 10220, Indonesia  
**Schedule**Full Time  
**Located Remotely?**N  
**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Assistant Controller manages the day-to-day operation of the Accounting Office. Primary responsibilities include financial analysis and financial reporting, budgeting/forecasting, audit and control, asset and liability reconciliation, working capital and cash control.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting; with experience minimal 5 years in the same field.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Assisting in Management of Accounting Team**

* Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

* Oversees internal, external and regulatory audit processes.

* Ensures that regular on-going communication occurs with employees to create awareness of business objectives, communicate expectations, and recognize performance.

* Celebrates successes by publicly recognizing the contributions of team members.

* Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees.

* Provides excellent leadership (e.g., differentiates top performers, fosters teamwork and encourages work/life balance).

* Ensures employees establish and maintain open, collaborative relationships within their team.

* Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.

* Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.

* Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.

* Utilizes an "open door" policy.

* Solicits employee feedback.

**Managing Projects and Policies**

* Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.

* Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

* Compiles, codes, categorizes, calculates, tabulates, audits, or verifies information or data.

* Ensures that the P&L is accurate (i.e., costs are properly matched to revenue, costs are recorded in the proper accounts) and statements are delivered to appropriate individuals in a timely manner.

* Reconciles balance sheet.

* Ensures tax rates used for sales/use tax are current and proper amounts are collected and/or accrued.

* Ensures compliance with standard and local operating procedures (SOPs and LSOPs).

* Ensures account balances are supported by appropriate documentation in accordance with SOPs.

* Reviews audit issues and makes corrections as necessary.

* Ensures property permits, licenses and if applicable vendor contracts are current.

* Leverages centralized accounting processes and shared services.

**Demonstrating and Applying Accounting Knowledge**

* Demonstrates knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.

* Keeps up-to-date technically and applying new knowledge to your job.

* Uses computers and computer systems (including hardware and software) to program, write software, set up functions, enter data, or process information.

* Uses relevant information and individual judgment to determine whether events or processes comply with laws, regulations, or standards.

* Leverages technology and effectively uses information systems and tools to generate financial reports and provide managers with analytical support to drive decision-making.

**Proving Financial Information and Guidance to Others**

* Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant financial information in a timely manner.

* Attends critique meetings to review information with management team.

* Advises the Director of Finance on existing and evolving operating/financial issues.

* Communicates financial concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand and drives desired behaviors.

* Provide direction and assistance to other organizational units regarding accounting and budgeting policies and procedures, and efficient control and utilization of financial resources.

* Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

**Maintaining Finance and Accounting Goals**

* Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.

* Ensures profits and losses are documented accurately.

* Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.

* Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.

* Monitors all taxes that apply, ensuring that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued.

* Supports a strong accounting & operational control environment to safeguard assets, improve operations and profitability and manage business risks.

*At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.*

At Le Méridien, we are inspired by the era of glamorous travel, celebrating each culture through the distinctly European spirit of savouring the good life. Our guests are curious and creative, cosmopolitan culture seekers that appreciate moments of connection and slowing down to savour the destination. We provide authentic, chic and memorable service along with experiences that inspire guests to savour the good life. We’re looking for curious and creative people to join our team. If you appreciate connecting with like-minded guests and have a deep desire to create memorable experiences, we invite you to explore career opportunities with Le Méridien. In joining Le Méridien, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. **Be** where you can do your best work, **begin** your purpose, **belong** to an amazing global team, and **become** the best version of you.

jobs.title: Sales Team Leader
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

* Lead, direct, and supervise the sales team in executing sales activities to achieve the company's established targets.
* Provide guidance, training, and coaching to team members on sales strategies, client communication, and product and service knowledge within the futures trading industry.
* Monitor and evaluate individual team performance regularly and provide constructive feedback to improve productivity and target achievement.
* Develop effective sales strategies to increase client acquisition and expand the company's business network.
* Ensure team members actively follow up with prospective clients through phone calls, messaging applications, and face-to-face meetings using company-provided databases.
* Assist team members in handling client inquiries, needs, and complaints while providing appropriate and professional solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients to support long-term business growth.
* Coordinate with the Assistant Branch Manager and management team regarding daily operational activities, sales reporting, and team development.
* Ensure all sales activities are conducted professionally and in accordance with company policies, procedures, and regulations.

Qualifications

* Minimum 1 year of experience in Sales, Marketing, Business Development, or a related field. Previous experience in leading a sales team is an advantage.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
* Demonstrated leadership abilities with the capacity to guide, motivate, and develop team members.
* Target-oriented, highly proactive, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly in addressing sales challenges.
* Ability to build and maintain professional relationships with clients.
* Capable of working independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
* Strong planning, organizational, and team performance evaluation skills.
* Willing to work with sales targets and maintain flexible working hours based on operational requirements.
* Previous experience as a Sales Team Leader, Sales Supervisor, Sales Consultant, Account Executive, or in a similar role is an advantage.
* Highly motivated to achieve sales targets and drive overall team success.

Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu

Pertanyaan Lamaran:

* Apakah Anda memiliki pengalaman kerja di bidang Customer Relation, Sales, Telesales, atau Account Executive?
* Apakah Anda bersedia bekerja dengan sistem target dan lingkungan kerja yang dinamis?
* Berapa ekspektasi gaji yang Anda harapkan untuk posisi ini?
* Mohon informasikan domisili tempat tinggal Anda saat ini.
* Berapa usia Anda saat ini?
* Jika lolos ke tahap berikutnya, kapan Anda tersedia untuk mengikuti proses interview?

Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Product Discovery Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
### **Company Overview**

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers fully integrated cloud-based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We continuously enhance our products and services, including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination, and billing.

### **Job Overview**

We are seeking a Product Discovery & Project Manager to lead early-stage product development by identifying client needs, gathering requirements, and translating business challenges into actionable product solutions.

You will work closely with clients, stakeholders, and technical teams to define product requirements, coordinate project execution, and ensure successful delivery. This role emphasizes product discovery, design thinking, requirements gathering, and project management, with product design supporting the development of user-centered solutions.

### **Key Responsibilities**

Product Discovery & Research

* Lead discovery sessions, client interviews, and user research, applying design thinking methodologies to identify business challenges, understand user needs, and uncover opportunities for product improvement.
* Conduct market and competitor research, analyze client feedback, and use design thinking principles to explore, evaluate, and validate potential solutions before development.

Requirements Gathering & Analysis

* Gather, analyze, and document client and business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflows.
* Collaborate with stakeholders and technical teams to clarify requirements, evaluate feasibility, and ensure alignment on project scope and expected outcomes.

Project Management & Execution

* Manage project scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and priorities from discovery through implementation.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams, monitor progress, resolve blockers, and communicate project updates to clients and leadership.

Product Strategy & Solution Development

* Translate research findings and business requirements into product recommendations aligned with user needs and company objectives.
* Collaborate with product leadership and technical teams to evaluate, prioritize, and plan product improvements.

Product Design & Prototyping

* Apply human-centered design principles to develop practical, intuitive, and user-friendly product solutions.
* Create or collaborate on wireframes, user flows, and basic *prototypes* to communicate concepts and validate requirements.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

* Serve as a liaison between clients, business stakeholders, and technical teams to maintain clear communication and alignment.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, address conflicting requirements, and facilitate discussions to support project decisions.

Leadership & Process Improvement

* Establish and improve processes, documentation standards, and best practices for product discovery, requirements gathering, and project management.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across product development

### **A Day in the Life**

Your day may involve meeting with clients to understand their workflows and gather requirements, applying design thinking techniques to explore potential solutions, and collaborating with developers to clarify technical specifications. You may also conduct product research, create workflow diagrams or basic *prototypes*, coordinate project priorities and timelines, and provide project updates to leadership.

Your primary focus is ensuring that client needs are clearly understood, product opportunities are thoroughly explored, requirements are well-defined, and projects move efficiently from discovery to delivery.

### **Success Metrics**

* Product Discovery & Design Thinking: Effective identification, exploration, and validation of client needs and product opportunities before development.
* Requirements Quality: Clear, complete documentation that minimizes misunderstandings and development rework.
* Project Delivery: Timely completion of project milestones and deliverables.
* Stakeholder Satisfaction: Effective communication and alignment between clients, leadership, and technical teams.
* Product Improvements: Delivery of solutions that improve client workflows, usability, and business outcomes.
* Process Efficiency: Continuous improvement in discovery, requirements gathering, and project management processes.

  

### **Job Details**

* Job Type: Full-time | Independent Contractor
* Location: Remote
* Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

Compensation will be based on location, experience, and qualifications.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Sales Manager, CFS - Data Center
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**What you will do:**

As a Sales Manager CFS for Data Center at JCI, you will be responsible for driving sales of our innovative Fire Control Security solutions to both new and existing Data Center customers. Your role will include understanding customer needs, developing tailored solutions, and effectively communicating and presenting these solutions to stakeholders. You will work closely with the sales team to convert leads into opportunities, ensuring customer satisfaction and adherence to sales targets.

**How you will do it:**

* Study product knowledge and company working procedures, continuously improving domain knowledge of product, company and industry.
* Plan annual secured order strategy aligned with Department goal. Achieve business sales target with YOY growth expectation in the region.
* Prepare and issue tenders and proposals to customers. Lead negotiation and/or bidding activity at optimum profit levels to the company. Close orders to achieve the goals and targets assigned.
* Responsible for payment collection.
* Provide monthly reporting on assigned vertical secured and revenue attainment as well as nonfinancial reporting to the management team.
* Be proactive to liaise, develop relationships and influence customer(s) to maintain a long-term service relationship, ensure customer satisfaction at high level.
* Develop sales leads and identify customer requirements.
* Monitor and collect competitors’ activities in the market and report periodically directed by the company.
* Independently develop and follow up the projects to provide solutions for customers.
* Compliance with Johnson Controls’ policies and procedures at all times.
* Identify and pursue new sales opportunities, leveraging strong technical knowledge of CFS systems.
* Responsible for the promotion of BMS/Fire products and systems in design institutes, industry associations and integrators in the industry in the region.
* Compiling the production of catalogues for customers. Prepare localized master catalogue and general applications for contractors and consultants where appropriate.
* Conduct cold calls and new business development.
* Explore and execute end-to-end BMS/Fire project and provide industry solution to customer.

**What we look for:**

* Minimum Degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Electronic Engineering or equivalent.
* At least 5 years of experience as Senior Sales in Controls, Fire & Security product.
* Experience in selling products to contractors, consultants, or company owners, and in handling projects.
* Knowledge of Fire Protection, Controls would be preferred.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer (26-07001)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Jadi bagian dari tim hebat dari perusahaan global.**
------------------------------------------------------

Bergabunglah dengan perusahaan global kami dan buka peluang tanpa batas dengan berkolaborasi bersama tim yang beragam dan berbakat. Bersama-sama, kami menciptakan kesuksesan, mendorong inovasi, dan menciptakan dunia dengan berbagai peluang yang tak terbatas.

  

### **Detail Pekerjaan**

* Conduct research about website and app UI and UX based on target audience, needs, and behaviors.
* Create wireframes (basic sketches) to outline the structure and layout of the website or app.
* Develop interactive UI/UX prototypes to demonstrate how the product will function.
* Design the look and feel of the product, including color schemes, typography, and iconography.
* Ensure the design aligns with the brand identity and is visually appealing.
* Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to bring designs to life.
* Create and maintain design systems or style guides to ensure consistency across the product.
* Document design standards and best practices.

### **Persyaratan Keahlian**

* Have minimum 3 years' experience as UI/UX Designer.
* Must have experience with design tools like Adobe XD, Figma etc.
* Must have experience in mobile and web design.
* Understand design practical and user centered digital experience using modern design tools methodologies.
* Can collaborate with team to improve UI/UX based expected output result.
* Strong understanding of design principles, including layout, color theory, and typography.
* Strong eye for detail in creating pixel-perfect designs.

### **Tingkat Pendidikan**

* Bachelor Degree of Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
* Diploma 3 Diploma from any discipline.

jobs.title: UI/UX Design (Full-Time)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Job Description:**

* Merancang user interface (UI) dan user experience (UX) untuk website, aplikasi, dan platform digital perusahaan.
* Melakukan riset pengguna untuk memahami kebutuhan, perilaku, dan permasalahan pengguna.
* Membuat user flow, wireframe, mockup, dan prototype sebagai acuan pengembangan produk digital.
* Mengembangkan desain yang intuitif, menarik, responsif, dan mudah digunakan.
* Melakukan usability testing serta mengevaluasi desain berdasarkan feedback pengguna.
* Berkolaborasi dengan tim Product Manager, Developer, dan tim terkait untuk memastikan desain dapat diimplementasikan sesuai kebutuhan.
* Mengembangkan dan memelihara design system serta menjaga konsistensi visual pada produk digital.
* Melakukan evaluasi dan perbaikan desain secara berkala berdasarkan hasil pengujian dan kebutuhan bisnis.
* Memastikan desain sesuai dengan prinsip usability, accessibility, dan responsive design.
* Mengikuti perkembangan tren desain UI/UX serta menerapkan praktik terbaik dalam pengembangan produk digital.

**Qualifications:**

* Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 di bidang Desain Komunikasi Visual, Desain Grafis, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait.
* Memiliki pengalaman sebagai UI/UX Designer menjadi nilai tambah.
* Menguasai Figma atau tools desain sejenis.
* Memahami prinsip UI/UX design, user-centered design, wireframing, prototyping, dan usability testing.
* Memiliki kemampuan menyusun user flow, wireframe, mockup, dan prototype interaktif.
* Memahami responsive design serta prinsip dasar accessibility.
* Memiliki portofolio desain UI/UX yang menunjukkan proses dan hasil perancangan.
* Memiliki kemampuan berpikir analitis, kreatif, dan berorientasi pada kebutuhan pengguna.
* Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun berkolaborasi dalam tim.
* Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan manajemen waktu yang baik.

Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu

Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

**T&T Consultant - Deloitte Digital (UI Designer) - ID**
========================================================

Date: 27 Oct 2026

Service Line / Portfolios: Customer

Location:
Jakarta, ID

**Are you ready to unleash your potential?**

  

At Deloitte, our purpose is to make an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and the communities we serve.

  

We believe we have a responsibility to be a force for good, and WorldImpact is our portfolio of initiatives focused on making a tangible impact on society’s biggest challenges and creating a better future. We strive to advise clients on how to deliver purpose-led growth and embed more equitable, inclusive as well as sustainable business practices.

  

Hence, we seek talented individuals driven to excel and innovate, working together to achieve our shared goals.

  

We are committed to creating positive work experiences that foster a culture of respect and inclusion, where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and everyone is recognised for their contributions.

  

Ready to unleash your potential with us? Join the winning team now!

  

**Work you'll do**

  

This role is with Deloitte Digital Southeast Asia. Across all clients and sectors, we believe great customer experiences create greater impact. That elevating the human experience creates enduring value, for the organization, for the customer, for society, for all.

  

As part of Customer Strategy & Design (CS&D), you will work with team to help our clients with their Brand Experiences, Products and Services, Innovation Strategies, Digital Venturing and Customer Experiences, bridging Business and Customer strategies by design. We help clients connect People, Product, Purpose and Profit through the use of strategy, design and technology.

  

Key Responsibilities:

  

* Design intuitive, visually engaging, and scalable user interfaces for large-scale digital platforms, including super apps, mobile applications, and complex web ecosystems.
* Translate business requirements, user insights, and UX wireframes into high-quality UI designs, interactive prototypes, and production-ready design specifications.
* Apply design system principles, reusable components, and visual standards to ensure consistency, accessibility, and scalability across multiple features and digital touchpoints.
* Collaborate with UX designers, product managers, business stakeholders, and technology teams to deliver seamless digital experiences aligned with business objectives and user needs.
* Contribute to design reviews, usability testing, and iterative improvements to enhance usability, visual quality, and overall customer experience.
* Support end-to-end design delivery, including developer handover, design QA, and refinement of implemented interfaces to ensure design fidelity.
  

**Your role as a leader:**

  

At Deloitte, we believe in the importance of empowering our people to be leaders at all levels. We connect our purpose and shared values to identify issues as well as to make an impact that matters to our clients, people and the communities. Additionally, Consultants across our Firm are expected to:

  

* Actively seek out developmental opportunities for growth, act as strong brand ambassadors for the firm as well as share their knowledge and experience with others.
* Respect the needs of their colleagues and build up cooperative relationships.
* Understand the goals of our internal and external stakeholder to set personal priorities as well as align their teams’ work to achieve the objectives.
* Constantly challenge themselves, collaborate with others to deliver on tasks and take accountability for the results.
* Build productive relationships and communicate effectively in order to positively influence teams and other stakeholders.
* Offer insights based on a solid understanding of what makes Deloitte successful.
* Project integrity and confidence while motivating others through team collaboration as well as recognising individual strengths, differences, and contributions.
* Understand disruptive trends and promote potential opportunities for improvement.
  

**Requirements:**

* Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 2–5 years of experience in UI design for digital products, preferably within digital consulting, product design, or technology-driven environments.
* Proven experience designing large-scale digital properties, such as super apps, multi-service platforms, digital banking applications, or complex consumer-facing ecosystems.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating visual design excellence, responsive interfaces, interaction design, and the ability to manage complex user journeys and multiple product features.
* Proficiency in Figma and experience working with design systems, component libraries, prototyping, and developer handover.
* Good understanding of usability, accessibility, responsive design principles, and platform-specific UI guidelines.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across business, design, and technology teams.
  

**Due to volume of applications, we regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.**

  

**Please note that Deloitte will never reach out to you directly via messaging platforms to offer you employment opportunities or request for money or your personal information. Kindly apply for roles that you are interested in via this official Deloitte website.**
