jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Product Designer**
====================

Product

On-site

Jakarta, Indonesia

**We’re Building the Future of Capital Markets;**
-------------------------------------------------

‍

enabling entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience*‍*

*As Asia's largest licensed digital securities exchange for alternative investments, Alta is at the forefront of building critical capital market infrastructure. We believe that access to capital markets are pivotal in all economies, we recognize that our role in building this critical infrastructure goes beyond facilitating trades; it paves the way for entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience, fostering a brighter future for emerging markets and economies.*

**Empowering Private Markets**: Through our Digital Exchange, we enable the tokenization and digital custody of alternative assets. This end-to-end solution simplifies and expedites the trading of smaller asset blocks, ultimately facilitating access and liquidity in private markets.

**Innovative Financial Ecosystem**: Our journey has seen us transition from securities trading and distribution of comprehensive products, including equities, private credit, funds, and asset-backed securities (“ABS”) (representing Real World Assets ("RWA") like whiskies, wines, art, watches, and real estate) to include fund management and digital custody services.

As the only integrated securities exchange, brokerage, and fund management group with the necessary regulatory licenses and a proven track record in Southeast Asia, we are actively exploring new channels and partnerships to extend our impact to entrepreneurs and investors globally.

Established in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, Alta operates offices globally. We welcome energetic and creative individuals to be part of this ambitious journey with us.

‍

**About The Role**
------------------

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our small, hands-on design team and help shape the platforms that power Alta’s marketplace for alternative investments. You’ll design features and flows across our core and client product suites, turning complex financial workflows and data into experiences that feel clear and intuitive for investors, issuers and internal teams.

Working closely with a senior designer, product managers and engineers, you’ll be involved in the full design process, from understanding the problem and supporting user research to prototyping, handoff and iteration after launch. This is a great fit for someone with a few years of product design experience who wants real ownership of their work, room to grow their craft, and the chance to learn a fast-moving corner of fintech along the way.

‍

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own features and flows end-to-end, from problem framing and research support through wireframes, prototypes, handoff and post-launch iteration, with guidance from a senior designer
* Turn complex workflows and financial data into clear, usable screens in Figma
* Use and contribute/iterate to our existing design system so products stay consistent
* Partner with PMs, engineers and QA to understand requirements and make sure designs ship as intended
* Maintain regular updates and communications with team members, ensure alignment on design decisions, and refine based on feedback with cross functional teams.

#### **In your first 6 months, you might**

* Ship features end to end, keep the experience consistent across products, and shape the design system
* Learn to work with our design libraries and system: create new components and patterns and help maintain and refine the existing ones
* Turn product requirements into flows and mockups, and run design sessions with PMs and engineers
* Stay involved throughout feature development and testing, balancing quality with speed.
‍

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Around 2–3 years of product design (UI/UX) experience, in-house, agency or freelance
* A strong portfolio with at least 2 case studies that show your process and what you learned, not just final screens
* At least one shipped product or feature you can talk discuss in detail
* Comfortable in Figma, with a working understanding of how software gets built
* Confident communicating in English, written and spoken, including explaining design decisions to non-designers
* Curious and open to feedback, with a genuine interest in growing your craft alongside a senior designer.
* Balances outcomes for both users and the business

#### **Preferred (Nice to have)**

* Experience with Jira, Confluence or product analytics tools
* Ability to leverage AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Figma AI) in your design workflow
* A solid understanding of the SDLC and how a product is delivered as end-to-end working software
* Prior experience in fintech, finance, or investment platforms is a plus
‍

If you are interested please send your resume to jobs@alta.exchange. Only successful applicants will be contacted.

This is a great fit for someone with a few years of product design experience who wants real ownership of their work, room to grow their craft, and the chance to learn a fast-moving corner of fintech along the way.

‍

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own features and flows end-to-end, from problem framing and research support through wireframes, prototypes, handoff and post-launch iteration, with guidance from a senior designer
* Turn complex workflows and financial data into clear, usable screens in Figma
* Use and contribute/iterate to our existing design system so products stay consistent
* Partner with PMs, engineers and QA to understand requirements and make sure designs ship as intended
* Maintain regular updates and communications with team members, ensure alignment on design decisions, and refine based on feedback with cross functional teams.

#### **In your first 6 months, you might**

* Ship features end to end, keep the experience consistent across products, and shape the design system
* Learn to work with our design libraries and system: create new components and patterns and help maintain and refine the existing ones
* Turn product requirements into flows and mockups, and run design sessions with PMs and engineers
* Stay involved throughout feature development and testing, balancing quality with speed.

‍

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Around 2–3 years of product design (UI/UX) experience, in-house, agency or freelance
* A strong portfolio with at least 2 case studies that show your process and what you learned, not just final screens
* At least one shipped product or feature you can talk discuss in detail
* Comfortable in Figma, with a working understanding of how software gets built
* Confident communicating in English, written and spoken, including explaining design decisions to non-designers
* Curious and open to feedback, with a genuine interest in growing your craft alongside a senior designer.
* Balances outcomes for both users and the business

#### **Preferred (Nice to have)**

* Experience with Jira, Confluence or product analytics tools
* Ability to leverage AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Figma AI) in your design workflow
* A solid understanding of the SDLC and how a product is delivered as end-to-end working software
* Prior experience in fintech, finance, or investment platforms is a plus

jobs.descriptionHtml:
**Responsibilities**

#BeOneofOurFaces!

Joining FACETOLOGY means becoming part of a dynamic beauty brand. We are a human-centric environment, driven by the purpose of enhancing quality of life through our products.

As a **Content Creator Intern**, you will:

* Develop and create daily content for social media according to brand's strandard
* Collaborate and brainstorm content plans and strategies with the editorial and social media teams to optimize content formats and performance
* Stay up to date with trends in social media and digital platforms (TikTok, Reels Instagram)
* Monitor and analyze content performance metrics (engagement, traffic, conversions)

 **Requirements**  

* Final-year students or fresh graduates (preferably from Marketing, Communications, or a related field).
* Prior experience or a strong interest in the beauty industry.
* Strong aesthetic sense and ability to identify the best product angles, especially for makeup content
* Proficient in photo and video shooting techniques (using either smartphone or camera)
* Actively follows trends such as Get Ready With Me, makeup challenges, tutorials, and other beauty-related content
* Creative and capable of generating engaging, out-of-the-box content ideas
* Ability to pose, perform voice-overs, and appear confidently on camera is a strong plus
* Willing to work from the office (WFO) in South Jakarta

**Kandidat yang sesuai dengan kualifikasi akan kami hubungi untuk dilanjutkan ke tahap berikutnya.**

***Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our recruitment team.***

Facetology is a local startup dedicated to advancing Indonesia’s beauty and personal care industry. At Facetology, creativity, expertise, and passion come together to meet the diverse needs of consumers nationwide. With an unwavering dedication to quality and innovation, we aim to set new standards and shape the future of beauty and personal care in Indonesia.

jobs.title: Social Media (Part Time)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
VPlus.id membuka kesempatan bagi individu yang kreatif, inovatif, dan memiliki ketertarikan di bidang **Graphic Design, Visual Communication, dan Branding** untuk bergabung sebagai **Graphic Designer (Part-Time)**.

Anda akan terlibat dalam pembuatan berbagai materi desain visual untuk kebutuhan branding, promosi, media sosial, serta komunikasi pemasaran perusahaan.

Tanggung Jawab

* Membuat desain visual untuk kebutuhan media sosial Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, dan platform digital lainnya.
* Mengembangkan desain konten kreatif, informatif, dan edukatif terkait perusahaan, pasar keuangan, perdagangan berjangka, serta layanan perusahaan.
* Membuat berbagai materi desain seperti poster, banner, flyer, brosur, infografis, dan materi promosi lainnya.
* Mengembangkan konsep visual dan layout desain sesuai identitas serta kebutuhan branding perusahaan.
* Melakukan editing dan penyesuaian desain berdasarkan arahan serta kebutuhan tim marketing.
* Memastikan konsistensi visual, kualitas desain, dan kesesuaian materi dengan brand guidelines perusahaan.
* Berkolaborasi dengan tim marketing dan social media dalam mendukung kebutuhan konten serta kampanye digital perusahaan.

Kualifikasi

* Mahasiswa aktif, mahasiswa tingkat akhir, atau fresh graduate dari jurusan Desain Komunikasi Visual (DKV), Desain Grafis, Multimedia, atau bidang relevan lainnya.
* Memiliki minat dan kemampuan dalam graphic design serta visual communication.
* Menguasai aplikasi desain seperti Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, CorelDRAW, atau tools desain lainnya.
* Memiliki pemahaman mengenai layout, typography, color theory, dan komposisi visual.
* Kreatif, memiliki sense of design yang baik, serta mampu mengembangkan konsep visual yang menarik.
* Memiliki kemampuan editing foto dan visual menjadi nilai tambah.
* Memiliki portofolio desain sebagai bahan pertimbangan.
* Proaktif, bertanggung jawab, teliti, dan mampu memenuhi deadline.
* Memiliki ketertarikan atau pengetahuan dasar mengenai industri keuangan dan perdagangan berjangka menjadi nilai tambah.
* **Berdomisili di Jakarta dan sekitarnya**, dengan prioritas kandidat yang mudah menjangkau kantor di Jakarta Selatan.
* Bersedia bekerja secara part-time dengan sistem hybrid serta **hadir ke kantor minimal 1–2 kali dalam seminggu** untuk koordinasi dan kebutuhan produksi desain.

Benefit

* Sistem kerja part-time dengan kombinasi Work From Home (WFH) dan Work From Office (WFO).
* Pengalaman langsung dalam pengembangan desain visual dan branding di perusahaan jasa keuangan.
* Kesempatan mengembangkan kreativitas, kemampuan desain, dan visual communication.
* Pengalaman berkolaborasi dengan tim marketing dan business development.
* Kesempatan membangun dan mengembangkan portofolio profesional.
* Sertifikat pengalaman kerja setelah menyelesaikan program, sesuai ketentuan perusahaan.

Jenis Pekerjaan: Magang

Pertanyaan Lamaran:

* Apakah Anda saat ini mahasiswa tingkat akhir atau fresh graduate lulusan 2025/2026? Jika mahasiswa, mohon sebutkan universitas dan jurusan Anda.
* Apakah Anda bersedia mengikuti program internship dengan sistem kerja hybrid (Work From Home & Work From Office)?
* Posisi ini merupakan unpaid internship. Apakah Anda bersedia melanjutkan proses seleksi dengan ketentuan tersebut?
* Kapan Anda dapat mulai mengikuti program internship jika dinyatakan lolos seleksi?
* Berapa lama durasi internship yang dapat Anda komitmenkan? (Contoh: 3 bulan / 6 bulan)

Lokasi Kerja: Kombinasi di kantor dan jarak jauh di Jakarta

jobs.title: Product Operations Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Product Operations Specialist bertanggung jawab untuk mendukung pengembangan dan optimalisasi produk pinjaman digital melalui riset pasar, analisis kompetitor, evaluasi pengalaman pengguna (UI/UX), serta pengujian proses produk secara menyeluruh.

Posisi ini juga berperan dalam merancang dan mengevaluasi program promosi serta campaign pemasaran di aplikasi, menganalisis perilaku pengguna, dan mengoptimalkan komunikasi kepada pelanggan untuk meningkatkan efektivitas produk dan pencapaian target bisnis.

B. Product Operations & Testing

* Berkolaborasi dengan tim Product dan IT dalam melakukan pengujian produk secara menyeluruh (End-to-End Testing).
* Melakukan pengujian dan evaluasi terhadap seluruh tahapan proses produk, mulai dari akuisisi pelanggan, penilaian kredit, penetapan harga, pencairan pinjaman, pelunasan, hingga pengajuan pinjaman kembali.
* Memastikan fitur dan alur produk berjalan sesuai dengan kebutuhan bisnis sebelum diluncurkan.
* Mengidentifikasi kendala operasional dan memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan produk.

C. Marketing Campaign & Promotion

* Berkolaborasi dengan tim Marketing dalam merancang dan mengembangkan program promosi serta campaign pemasaran di aplikasi.
* Mengembangkan ide promosi seperti cashback, diskon biaya, voucher, dan program loyalitas pelanggan sesuai kebijakan perusahaan.
* Memberikan masukan terkait tampilan UI/UX campaign, pesan promosi, banner aplikasi, serta strategi komunikasi pelanggan.
* Melakukan evaluasi terhadap efektivitas campaign dan memberikan rekomendasi untuk meningkatkan engagement dan conversion rate.

D. User Behavior & Communication Analysis

* Menganalisis pola perilaku dan kebutuhan pengguna untuk mendukung pengembangan produk dan strategi pemasaran.
* Berpartisipasi dalam penyusunan dan evaluasi pesan komunikasi pemasaran maupun penagihan.
* Melakukan evaluasi terhadap berbagai media komunikasi pelanggan, termasuk push notification, SMS, komunikasi berbasis AI, serta script telemarketing dan agen penagihan.
* Memberikan rekomendasi untuk meningkatkan efektivitas komunikasi dan pengalaman pelanggan dengan tetap memperhatikan ketentuan yang berlaku.

Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu

Pendidikan:

* S1 (Diwajibkan)

Pengalaman:

* 1 tahun: 1 tahun (Diwajibkan)

Bahasa:

* mandarin (Diwajibkan)

Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

Product Operations & Testing * Berkolaborasi dengan tim Product dan IT dalam melakukan pengujian produk secara menyeluruh (End-to-End Testing). * Melakukan pengujian dan evaluasi terhadap seluruh tahapan proses produk, mulai dari akuisisi pelanggan, penilaian kredit, penetapan harga, pencairan pinjaman, pelunasan, hingga pengajuan pinjaman kembali. * Memastikan fitur dan alur produk berjalan sesuai dengan kebutuhan bisnis sebelum diluncurkan. * Mengidentifikasi kendala operasional dan memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan produk. C. Marketing Campaign & Promotion * Berkolaborasi dengan tim Marketing dalam merancang dan mengembangkan program promosi serta campaign pemasaran di aplikasi. * Mengembangkan ide promosi seperti cashback, diskon biaya, voucher, dan program loyalitas pelanggan sesuai kebijakan perusahaan. * Memberikan masukan terkait tampilan UI/UX campaign, pesan promosi, banner aplikasi, serta strategi komunikasi pelanggan. * Melakukan evaluasi terhadap efektivitas campaign dan memberikan rekomendasi untuk meningkatkan engagement dan conversion rate. D. User Behavior & Communication Analysis * Menganalisis pola perilaku dan kebutuhan pengguna untuk mendukung pengembangan produk dan strategi pemasaran. * Berpartisipasi dalam penyusunan dan evaluasi pesan komunikasi pemasaran maupun penagihan. * Melakukan evaluasi terhadap berbagai media komunikasi pelanggan, termasuk push notification, SMS, komunikasi berbasis AI, serta script telemarketing dan agen penagihan. * Memberikan rekomendasi untuk meningkatkan efektivitas komunikasi dan pengalaman pelanggan dengan tetap memperhatikan ketentuan yang berlaku. jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Lemon.io

Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. We’ve been in business for 10 years, have 60 people across Ukraine, Europe, Canada, and the US, and process over $16M in annual GMV. We compress the traditional 2–5 week hiring timeline down to 24–48 hours through a curated, pre-vetted supply of developers.

Hiring is still broken. Recruiters spend weeks building candidate pipelines on traditional platforms, burning energy on unqualified leads. We’re building the product that changes that. Giving recruiters qualified, vetted candidates within 24 hours without the grind. This is a pivotal moment: we’re transitioning from a services-driven marketplace to a technology-driven platform. We need an engineering leader who can drive that transformation.

 

The Role

You will own engineering at Lemon.io. You’ll lead a growing team of engineers, make critical architecture and prioritization decisions, and be directly accountable for the speed and quality of what we ship. This is not a management-layer role. You’ll be hands-on, deeply involved in product decisions, and working side by side with the founder.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake.

  • Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost.

  • Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is.

  • Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill.

  • Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code.

  • Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy.

Who You Are:

  • Product-minded, business-first

  • Obsessed with simplicity

  • First principles thinker

  • Fast. Bias toward action

Experience:

  • You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company.

  • You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling.

  • You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team.

Why Lemon.io:

  • Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals.

  • A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open.

  • Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship.

  • A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers.

  • A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.descriptionHtml:
AI Trainer - Video Annotation

Remote   |   Independent Contractor   

Prove your skills. Get certified. 

Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. 


▌ What you will do

As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to:

  • Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events.

  • Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines.

  • Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements.

  • Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues.

▌ What you bring

  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

  • Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently.

  • A commitment to accuracy and consistency.

  • No previous AI or robotics experience required.

▌ What the work looks like

You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible.


Please note:  We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Contractor
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

  • Strong internet connection.

  • Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.

*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.

Post Training:

We are currently seeking representatives to work on the following schedule:

Monday - Friday

Shift hours to be discussed with our hiring manager based on our company's needs at the time of hire. Shifts are as follows:

  • 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM EST

  • 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM EST

  • 9:00 AM - 5:00 AM EST

  • 9:30 AM - 5:30 PM EST

  • 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST

  • 10:30 AM - 6:30 PM EST

  • 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM EST

  • 11:30 AM - 7:30 PM EST

  • 12:30 PM - 8:30 PM EST

  • 1:30 PM - 9:30 PM EST

  • 2:30 PM - 10:30 PM EST

  • 3:00 PM - 11:00 PM EST

Job Type: Contract

Shift:

  • 8 hour shift

  • Day shift

  • Evening shift

  • Morning shift

  • Night shift

Supplemental Pay:

  • Bonus opportunities

  • Commission pay

Experience:

  • Sales: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: Freelance Writer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our organization is seeking content writers to create articles and blog posts on a variety of topics.

 

The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour).

 

Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know):

 

  • Health & beauty
  • Fitness
  • Home Decor
  • Fashion
  • Sports
  • Do it yourself
  • Finance
  • Legal
  • Medical
  • Family/Parenting
  • Relationships
  • Real Estate
  • Restaurants
  • Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.)

 

These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover.

 

Requirements:

  • We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office
  • A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines
  • Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc
  • Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff



Note: Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.descriptionHtml:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you a talented Senior Developer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

 

What we offer:

  • The rate depends on your seniority level, skills and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers.
  • No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — let us handle the business side of things so you can focus on what you do best.
  • We'll manually find the best project for you according to your skills and preferences.
  • Choose a schedule that works best for you. It’s possible to communicate async or minimally overlap within team working hours.
  • We respect your seniority so you can expect no micromanagement or screen trackers.
  • Communicate directly with the clients. Most of them have technical backgrounds. Sounds good, yeah?
  • We will support you from the time you submit the application throughout all cooperation stages.
  • Most of our projects involve working in a fast-paced startup environment. We hope you like it as much as we do.

 

Requirements for the Senior React & Python Position:
  • 4+ years of software development experience.

Commercial experience:

  • React.js 3+ years & Python 3+ years

    OR
    React.js 2+ years & Python 5+ years
    OR
    React.js 5+ years & Python 2+ years

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure is required.

 

Other requirements:

  • Strong technical skills: as a Senior Developer, you are expected to be able to create projects from scratch and have a deep understanding of application architecture.
  • Clear and effective communication in English — advanced ability to discuss business tasks, justify decisions, and communicate issues. Good self-presentation is also essential for upcoming client calls.
  • Strong self-organizational skills — ability to work full-time remotely with no supervision.
  • Reliability — we want to trust you and expect that you won’t let us and the client down.
  • Adaptability and Flexibility — the ability to onboard the project promptly after accepting it and start delivering results quickly.

 

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

jobs.title: Warehouse Trainer (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Bei Knuspr zählt Geschwindigkeit. Qualität zählt. Aber nichts davon funktioniert ohne Menschen, die vom ersten Tag an genau wissen, was sie tun.

Genau hier kommen unsere Trainer ins Spiel.

Wir suchen einen Warehouse Trainer (m/w/d), der neuen Kolleg:innen hilft, sich schnell einzuarbeiten, die Abläufe richtig zu lernen und sich zu selbstbewussten, leistungsstarken Teammitgliedern zu entwickeln. Diese Rolle verbindet Onboarding, Coaching und Kulturarbeit – und ist ein zentraler Bestandteil dafür, wie gut unsere Teams im Lager funktionieren.

Wenn du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest, durch Vorleben erklärst und andere jeden Tag besser machen willst, könnte das gut zu dir passen.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Du hast direkten Einfluss darauf, wie schnell neue Mitarbeitende produktiv und sicher arbeiten

  • Du prägst die Teamkultur auf der Lagerfläche – nicht vom Schreibtisch aus

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Führungskräften zusammen und bist wichtiger Partner für Performance, Onboarding und Entwicklung

  • Du unterstützt sowohl neue als auch bestehende Mitarbeitende – kein Tag ist wie der andere

  • Du bist die Person, auf die andere sich verlassen: für Orientierung, Klarheit und Unterstützung

Deine Aufgaben

Du unterstützt Mitarbeitende im Lager dabei, sich weiterzuentwickeln und erfolgreich zu sein.

Du wirst:

  • Das Onboarding neuer Lager-Mitarbeitender koordinieren

  • Mitarbeitende in verschiedenen Lagerbereichen und Prozessen schulen

  • Trainingsmaterialien und Methoden mitentwickeln und verbessern

  • Regelmäßig Feedback geben, motivieren und Leistung fördern

  • Unterstützungsbedarfe erkennen und praxisnahe Entwicklungspläne erstellen

  • Die Einhaltung von Lagerprozessen und -regeln überprüfen

  • Eng mit Führungskräften bei Trainings- und Entwicklungsmaßnahmen zusammenarbeiten

  • Neue Prozesse im Lager begleiten und Teams dabei unterstützen, diese zu verstehen

  • Trainingserfolge evaluieren und Verbesserungen ableiten

  • Als zentrale Ansprechperson für Fragen und Unterstützung auf der Fläche agieren

  • Als Vorbild für Knuspr-Kultur, Teamarbeit und Kundenorientierung auftreten

Was wir suchen

  • Mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung im Training (Lager- oder Operations-Erfahrung von Vorteil)

  • Hands-on-Mentalität und Offenheit für ein dynamisches, schnelles Umfeld

  • Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Freude an der Arbeit mit Menschen

  • Ruhe und Fairness auch unter Druck

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Fokus auf Weiterentwicklung anderer

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Apps, Tools und neuen Technologien

  • Selbstständige, proaktive Arbeitsweise

  • Stark ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung, auch im operativen Alltag

Sprachkenntnisse: Du benötigst sehr gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse. Weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

Was wir bieten

  • Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf den Unternehmenserfolg

  • Gute Ideen werden schnell umgesetzt – ohne lange Konzernprozesse

  • Keine starren Corporate-Strukturen

  • Die Möglichkeit, Dinge wirklich zu verändern und nicht nur Trends zu folgen

  • Faire Vergütung sowie Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und Weiterbildung

  • Teil eines engagierten Teams und Teilnahme an besonderen Company-Events

#LI-AR1 #Knuspr

jobs.title: Warehouse Trainer (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Knuspr, speed matters. Quality matters. But none of it works without people who know what they’re doing from day one.

That’s where our trainers come in.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Trainer who will help new colleagues settle in fast, learn the job properly, and grow into confident, high-performing team members. This role is part onboarding, part coaching, part culture-building — and a big part of what makes our warehouse teams work well together.

If you enjoy working with people, teaching by example, and helping others improve every day, this could be a great fit.

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll have a direct impact on how quickly new employees become productive and confident.

  • You’ll help shape team culture on the warehouse floor — not from behind a desk.

  • You’ll work closely with managers and become a key partner in performance, onboarding and development.

jobs.title: AI Tutor/Lehrkraft (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
AI Tutor/Lehrkraft (all genders)

Du brennst für GenAI und Large Language Models und möchtest Dein Wissen nicht nur anwenden, sondern auch weitergeben? Als KI Tutor/Lehrkraft begleitest Du unsere Teilnehmenden fachlich und didaktisch auf ihrem Weg zu praxisnahen KI-Kompetenzen: Du beantwortest ihre Fragen rund um GenAI, LLMs und verantwortungsvollen KI-Einsatz, unterstützt sie in Übungen und Projekten und sorgst dafür, dass sie KI-Tools am Ende nicht nur verstehen, sondern sicher und reflektiert in ihrem Arbeitsalltag einsetzen können.

Du bewertest Lernfortschritte, führst Abschlussprüfungen durch und gibst strukturiertes, konstruktives Feedback. Durch den engen Kontakt zu den Lernenden trägst Du außerdem aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Trainingsprogramme bei – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Coaching Team Lead, dem Learning Team und weiteren Schnittstellen.

Schwerpunkte Deiner Rolle

  • Fachliche Beantwortung von Fragen der Lernenden (schriftlich und mündlich)

  • Vermittlung und Vertiefung von Trainingsinhalten in Live-Sessions, Webinaren, Classrooms und individueller Lernbegleitung

  • Begleitung bei Unsicherheiten im Lernprozess sowie in Übungen und Projekten

  • Durchführung und Bewertung von Abschlussprüfungen sowie Entscheidung über den Trainingserfolg

  • Erstellung, Aufbereitung und Weiterentwicklung von Lernmaterialien rund um praktische GenAI/LLM-Fähigkeiten, grundlegende KI/ML-Kompetenz und verantwortungsvollen, ethischen KI-Einsatz

  • Qualitätssicherung bestehender Trainings inkl. Feedback ans Learning-Team

  • Durchführung individueller Coaching-Sessions und Unterstützung neuer Teammitglieder

Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation in einem quantitativen, analytischen oder technischen Fachbereich

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner KI-Konzepte – insbesondere GenAI mit Fokus auf LLMs, inkl. Grundverständnis von Trainingsdaten, Modellen, Evaluierung und typischen KI-Limitierungen (Machine Learning und Deep Learning sind ein Plus)

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Nutzung von LLMs (z. B. Prompt-Engineering, Workflow-Integration, Agenten) sowie mit No-/Low-Code-KI-Tools

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit (einfachen) API-Clients (z. B. Postman, curl); gute Python-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit SQL, Power BI oder Excel sind von Vorteil

  • Bewusstsein für ethische, rechtliche und organisatorische Aspekte von KI-Anwendungen sowie Interesse an aktuellen Entwicklungen im KI-Sektor

  • Didaktische Erfahrung in der Vermittlung technischer oder fachlicher Inhalte an nicht-technische Zielgruppen sowie Verständnis für Konzepte der Erwachsenenbildung und Online-Weiterbildung

  • Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung, Empathie, klare Kommunikation und konstruktive Feedbackkultur

  • Hands-on-Mentalität, Teamgeist, Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)

Das bieten wir Dir

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.


Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung
Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

jobs.title: Career Coach (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

Als Career Coach begleitest Du unsere Lernenden auf dem entscheidendsten Abschnitt ihres Weges: dem Sprung in den neuen Job. Mit gezieltem Bewerbungscoaching, individueller Karriereberatung und einer klaren Portion Motivation machst Du aus Unsicherheit, Selbstvertrauen und Qualifikationen echte Jobangebote.

Unsere Kurse vermitteln unseren Teilnehmenden echte, marktfähige Kompetenzen. Du sorgst dafür, dass diese auch von der Außenwelt gesehen werden, indem Du ihnen hilfst, ihre neuen Fähigkeiten sichtbar zu machen, selbstbewusst zu kommunizieren und in überzeugende Bewerbungen zu verwandeln.

Dabei bist Du nicht allein: Der Coaching-Prozess ist strukturiert, die Qualität abgesichert, und Du arbeitest eng mit dem Career Coaching Lead zusammen. Dein Fokus: Teilnehmende begleiten, dass sie ihren Berufseinstieg mit Klarheit und Zuversicht angehen.

Schwerpunkte Deiner Rolle

  • Leitung eigener Kurse und Workshops zu Bewerbungsstrategien, Interview Training, Motivation und beruflicher Neuorientierung

  • 1:1-Coaching zur Unterstützung bei Jobsuche, Interviewvorbereitung und der Erstellung persönlicher Kompetenzprofile

  • Unterstützung bei professionellen Bewerbungsunterlagen und der Entwicklung einer klaren beruflichen Positionierung

  • Förderung von Motivation und Teilnehmenden Bindung durch eine vertrauensvolle, positive Coaching-Atmosphäre

  • Auf- und Ausbau eines aktiven Firmen- und Alumni-Netzwerks zur Förderung von Austausch, Kooperation und erfolgreicher Vermittlung

  • Analyse und Weiterentwicklung interner Career-Success-Prozesse sowie Unterstützung des Client Operations & Career Coaching Lead bei strategischen Projekten

  • Dokumentation und Reporting von Vermittlungsquoten, Coaching-Aktivitäten und Feedback an den Career Coaching Lead

Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation in Pädagogik, Psychologie oder Coaching

  • Erfahrung in Karriereberatung, Bewerbungscoaching oder Lernbegleitung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools (z. B. MS Office, CRM-Systeme, Projektmanagement-Tools) sowie Routine in der Erstellung von Präsentationen für Trainings, Management und Kooperationspartner

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du passt Deine Ansprache an individuelle Bedürfnisse an und moderierst Gruppen sicher

  • Eigenständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, auch bei der parallelen Steuerung mehrerer Career Coaching-Prozesse

  • Einfühlungsvermögen, Empathie und aktives Zuhören

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About SANOVIO

SANOVIO makes buying and selling medical supplies easier. On our AI platform, hospitals, purchasing groups and suppliers work together in one place instead of juggling emails, Excel lists and disconnected systems. Hospitals can buy together, and suppliers reach that bundled demand more easily.

Our software, SANOVIO aOS, uses AI agents to take over the tedious work: cleaning up product data, comparing requests and offers, bundling demand and keeping orders on track. It connects to the systems our customers already use.

When needed, SANOVIO Fulfillment also takes care of the physical side: finding manufacturers worldwide, quality checks, financing, warehousing and delivery. The goal is simple: less admin work, and more time and money for patient care.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the bridge between our customers and our product, on both sides of the platform: healthcare providers and purchasing groups on one side, suppliers on the other. At its core, this role is about talking to customers. You work directly with procurement, logistics and IT teams, understand how they really work and make SANOVIO work inside their world: you connect our platform to their ERP, materials management and supplier systems, untangle their data and processes, and ship the solutions that make them successful.

This role is for builders who are just as comfortable in a customer workshop as in a code editor. Whether you studied business informatics, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics, or bring experience in technical product management, product engineering or software engineering with a strong design sense: what matters is that you love solving messy real-world problems end to end. We hire for skills, not for degrees.

Tasks

  • Talking to our customers every day: leading workshops with procurement managers, IT departments and suppliers, and being a trusted partner for our customers

  • Owning customer implementations end to end, from kickoff and process analysis to go-live and continuous improvement

  • Analyzing and redesigning procurement processes on both sides, from requisition and ordering at healthcare providers to order handling at suppliers, and uncovering optimization potential

  • Designing, building and running integrations between SANOVIO and our customers' ERP systems (such as SAP), materials management and supplier systems

  • Onboarding and harmonizing customer data (e.g. article master data, catalogs, order histories) and building robust data pipelines and mappings

  • Configuring and extending our AI agents for customer-specific workflows such as data matching and order automation

  • Prototyping and shipping customer-facing workflows, tools and dashboards with a strong focus on usability for non-technical users

  • Bringing customer insights back into the product and turning recurring solutions into product features together with our engineering team and the founders

Communication and customer focus

  • You enjoy talking to customers: you listen carefully, ask the right questions and explain technical topics in plain language

  • Native-level German and very good English, so you can confidently lead conversations and workshops with our customers

  • Confident with all kinds of stakeholders, from procurement managers to IT departments

  • Willing to work on-site in Munich and to travel regularly to customers in Germany and Switzerland

General Profile

  • Degree in Business Informatics (Wirtschaftsinformatik), Industrial Engineering (Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen), Computer Science, Mathematics or a similar field. Skills matter more to us than your degree, so equivalent hands-on experience counts just as much

  • Strong process understanding: you enjoy mapping, analyzing and improving business processes such as procure-to-pay or supply chain

  • High ownership, structured problem-solving and the drive to deliver fast in ambiguous environments

  • This is a junior role: a great fit if you're a recent graduate or have up to five years of professional experience. Internships and working student jobs count too

Technical skillset

  • First hands-on experience with system integrations and interfaces (e.g. REST APIs, webhooks, EDI or file-based interfaces), whether from work, internships or university projects

  • Solid coding skills (e.g. TypeScript/JavaScript or Python) and good SQL and data skills

  • Product and design affinity: you care about UX and can turn complex workflows into simple, intuitive interfaces. Experience with Figma or building UIs is a plus

Bonus if you

  • Worked at a startup or software company focused on SAP/ERP, integration platforms, process mining or procurement software (internships and working student jobs count too)

  • Have first experience as a Technical PM, Product Engineer, Solutions or Implementation Engineer, or ERP consultant

  • Have built with LLMs or AI agents, e.g. for data extraction or matching

  • Bring domain knowledge in healthcare, hospitals, procurement or supply chain

  • Can share a portfolio, GitHub or case studies of projects you shipped

Benefits

  • A steep learning curve: you learn integration work, process consulting and product building at the same time, working closely with the founders

  • Real ownership and direct impact on how we work with our customers

  • Great central office in Munich with regular team events and dinners

  • Monthly wellness budget

  • Access to the AI and productivity tools you need

  • Regular customer visits across Germany and Switzerland

  • Compensation package including cash, performance bonus and shares

About the interview process

Step 1: Intro call

Casual intro call to get to know each other, introduce SANOVIO and talk about your experience.

Step 2: Case study

A practical case based on a real-world challenge from our platform, for example how you would connect a hospital or a supplier to SANOVIO and redesign its ordering process. You'll present your approach to the team, just like you would to a customer.

Step 3: Personal fit

Meet one of our co-founders to get a feel for our culture and working style.

Step 4: Offer & reference checks

If we see a great fit, you will get an offer, including a competitive compensation package. We'll also ask for two to three references.

jobs.title: Working student SAP CoC  (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Transform with us the future of energy ⚡

The SGB‑SMIT Group is an international transformer manufacturer with locations in Europe, Asia and America. With reliable transformer technology, the company actively supports the global energy transition in areas such as renewable energy, industry and urban energy infrastructure.

As a key link between power generation, transmission and distribution, SGB‑SMIT Group develops and manufactures power transformers, distribution transformers, cast‑resin transformers and custom solutions for data centers, industrial applications and e‑mobility. These products ensure efficient, stable and secure energy flows worldwide.

With more than 3,800 employees worldwide, the SGB‑SMIT Group stands for quality, innovation and sustainability and offers a stable environment to work on technologies that shape the energy systems of the future.

What sets the SGB-SMIT Group apart: 🌍

We combine the strength of an international technology company with an employee-oriented corporate culture:

  • Meaningful work at the heart of the energy transition

  • Short decision-making processes and direct cooperation

  • Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

Your contribution counts – both professionally and personally.

Your benefits at SGB-SMIT Group: 🚀

  • Flexible working hours

  • Various home office options

  • Personal development and further training

  • Excellent health management

  • Fitness pass in cooperation with Hanse Fit

  • Excellent company restaurant and free drinks (coffee, water)

  • Company parking spaces with charging facilities for electric vehicles

  • Various discounts as part of Benify Benefits (Apple, Nike, Dell, Zalando, etc.)

Your tasks: 📌

  • Support testing activities in SAP ECC and SAP S/4 environments

  • Document incidents and user stories, with a focus on identifying recurring issues and trends

  • Process standard changes (service requests)

  • Identify IT-related challenges and develop suitable solution approaches

  • Support the preparation and follow-up of workshops, meetings, and research activities

  • Contribute to user management concepts and depending on experience level, support ABAP programming analyses

Your profile: 🔎

  • Interest in SAP, business processes, and digitalization

  • Initial experience with SAP applications; ABAP knowledge or SAP certification is a plus

  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks after the onboarding phase

  • Very good German and English language skills, both written and spoken

If you value a dynamic, growing, and intercultural environment and enjoy hands-on work, then become part of the SGB-SMIT Group - transform with us the future of energy. ⚡

We look forward to receiving your application! ⚡

Learn more about the SGB-SMIT Group as an employer, our values, and career opportunities on our careers page:

https://www.sgb-smit.com/career-jobs/sgb-smit-group#/

The terms used in this text refer to all genders in accordance with the General Equal Treatment Act (AGG).

jobs.title: Mitarbeiter / Leiter (w|m|d) interne Qualitätssicherung Wirtschaftsprüfung – Vollzeit oder Teilzeit
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Der Verband Sächsischer Wohnungsgenossenschaften e. V. (VSWG) ist gesetzlicher Prüfungsverband sowie Fach- und Interessenverband der sächsischen Wohnungsgenossenschaften. In den Bereichen Prüfung, Beratung, Weiterbildung und Interessenvertretung begleitet der VSWG seine Mitgliedsgenossenschaften.

Mit Genauigkeit für geprüfte Qualität

Als Mitarbeiter / Leiter (w/m/d) übernehmen Sie eine wichtige Rolle in der internen auftragsbezogenen Qualitätssicherung der Wirtschaftsprüfung. Genauigkeit, Struktur und fachliche Tiefe prägen dabei Ihren Arbeitsalltag. Ihre Tätigkeit umfasst insbesondere die formelle und materielle Berichtskritik:

  • Sie prüfen Prüfungsberichte auf Zahlenkonsistenz, inhaltliche Plausibilität und sprachliche Korrektheit und berücksichtigen dabei interne Qualitätsstandards und Fristen.

  • Sie stellen die formelle und fachliche Richtigkeit sowie die Vollständigkeit der Berichte sicher.

  • Tabellen und Texte kontrollieren Sie auf rechnerische und orthografische Korrektheit.

  • Hinweise auf mögliche Bilanzierungsfehler identifizieren Sie und geben diese entsprechend weiter.

  • Sie pflegen Berichtsdateien, bereiten diese vor und übernehmen die finale Aufbereitung.

Zudem wirken Sie an der Fortentwicklung, Durchsetzung und Überwachung des gemäß § 55b WPO bestehenden internen Qualitätssicherungssystems mit.


Fachliches Know-how trifft auf sorgfältiges Arbeiten

Für die Berichtsprüfung und Berichtskritik bringen Sie ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und Zusammenhänge mit. Eine strukturierte und präzise Arbeitsweise bildet die Grundlage für Ihre Tätigkeit.

  • Erfahrungen in der Durchführung von Abschlussprüfungen

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Bilanzierung

  • Idealerweise Branchenkenntnisse in der Immobilienwirtschaft

  • Gutes Verständnis für finanzbuchhalterische und steuerliche Zusammenhänge

  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Hohes Maß an Diskretion und Vertrauenswürdigkeit

  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Word, Excel und Outlook, sowie mit gängigen Videokonferenz-Tools

Rahmenbedingungen für Ihre berufliche Entwicklung

Beim VSWG verbinden sich fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten mit Rahmenbedingungen, die die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben unterstützen.

  • Regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Arbeitsmodelle

  • Digitales Arbeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene, kollegiale Zusammenarbeit

  • Über 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr

  • Hohe Work-Life-Balance

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents

  • Freistellungen zu besonderen Anlässen

Interesse an Ihrem Einstieg in die Wirtschaftsprüfung?

Die DOMUS Consult Wirtschaftsberatung begleitet den Bewerbungsprozess für den VSWG. In einem persönlichen und unverbindlichen Gespräch können Sie herausfinden, ob die Position und der VSWG zu Ihren beruflichen Vorstellungen passen.

Ihr Ansprechpartner ist Florian Kausch. Senden Sie Ihre Bewerbung an Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.
