jobs.title: UAV Engineer Working Student (All Genders)
jobs.descriptionText: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners &nbsp;with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.</span><br><br></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">WHY JOIN US</span></strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&amp;D backing.</span></li> </ul></div><p><strong>ABOUT THE TEAM</strong></p> <p>You will join our C-UAS Edge Software engineering team dedicated to building resilient counter-unmanned aerial system technologies. The team works closely across hardware and software disciplines to deploy real-time software on edge systems. We value rapid iteration, field testing, and collaborative problem-solving to meet critical defence challenges.</p> <p><strong>YOUR MISSION</strong></p> <p>As a UAV Engineer (Working Student) – C-UAS Edge Software, you will support the design, development, and testing of edge software running on autonomous UAV and counter-UAS platforms. You will collaborate directly with software and hardware</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and integrate C-UAS software components for edge processing and embedded Linux environments.</li> <li>Assist in real-time signal processing, sensor fusion, and telemetry data pipeline implementation.</li> <li>Conduct software testing in simulation environments and support physical field testing on UAV hardware.</li> <li>Optimize software algorithms for low-power edge hardware and embedded computing units.</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve hardware-software integration issues.</li> <li>Maintain clear technical documentation and automated test suites for software releases.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION</strong></p> <ul> <li>Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field.</li> <li>Solid programming experience in C++ and/or Python.</li> <li>Basic understanding of Linux operating systems, networking protocols, and embedded system environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with UAV architectures, robotics frameworks (e.g., ROS/ROS2), or drone flight controllers (e.g., PX4, ArduPilot).</li> <li>Fluency in English; strong communication and teamwork skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>NICE TO HAVE</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing or field flight testing of unmanned aircraft.</li> <li>Experience with edge AI acceleration hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, Coral).</li> <li>Knowledge of RF technologies, radar systems, or optical sensing for counter-drone applications.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your <strong>CV in English</strong>. We're looking forward to meeting you!</span></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>SECURITY CLEARANCE</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>EQUAL OPPORTUNITY</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>DATA PRIVACY STATEMENT</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This data privacy statement, which refers exclusively to data collected as part of the online application process, is to inform you about how your personal data that is collected as part of the online application process is handled at our end.</span></p> <p><strong>The controller</strong></p> <p>The controller under data protection law is:</p> <p>SKD SE</p> <p><strong>Französische Strasse 12, 10117 Berlin</strong></p> <p>Commercial register entry number: <strong>HRB 260878</strong></p> <p>Registration Court: Amtsgericht Charlottenburg</p> <p><strong>Data Protection officer:</strong> heyData GmbH, Schützenstraße 5, 10117 Berlin,<a href="http://www.heydata.eu"> www.heydata.eu</a>, ----- <p><em><strong>Personal data collected as part of the application process</strong></em></p> <p>Personal data means any information concerning the personal or material circumstances of an identified or identifiable individual. This includes information such as, for example, your name, address, telephone number and date of birth, but also data relating to your specific career etc. by reference to which a specific individual can be identified with reasonable effort. However, information which cannot be (in)directly associated with your real-life identity is not personal data.</p> <p>Fundamentals and purposes of processing personal data collected from application documents and during the application process</p> <p>If you apply to us electronically, i.e. via e-mail or using our online form, we will collect and process your personal data for the purpose of executing the application process and preparing contracts.</p> <p>By submitting an application via our recruitment website, you express your interest in taking up work with us. In this context, you transmit personal data, which we will use and store exclusively for the purpose of your job search / application process.</p> <p>In particular, the following data is collected during this process:</p> <ul> <li>name (first and last names)</li> <li>e-mail address</li> <li>phone number</li> <li>LinkedIn profile (optional)</li> <li>channel through which you found us</li> </ul> <p>Furthermore, you can choose to upload expressive documents such as a cover letter, your CV and reference letters. These may contain additional personal data such as date of birth, address etc.</p> <p>Only authorized HR staff and/or staff involved in the application process have access to your data.</p> <p>The personal data is stored, as a rule, exclusively for the purpose of filling the vacancy for which you have applied.</p> <p>Your data will be stored for a period of 180 days after the application process has been concluded. This is usually done to fulfill legal requirements and/or defending ourselves against any claims arising from legal provisions. After this period, we are obligated to delete or anonymize your data. In case of anonymization, the data will only be available to us in the form of so-called metadata, without any direct personal reference, for statistical analysis (for example, share of male and/or female applicants, number of applications per specified period of time etc.).</p> <p>Furthermore, we reserve the right to store your data for 180 days after the application process has been concluded for the purpose of adding it to our Talent Pool in order to identify any other vacancies that may be of interest to you. This includes, for example, applications for apprenticeships or internships. By accepting the data privacy statement, you consent to any further storage of your data as well as its inclusion in our Talent Pool.</p> <p>Should you be offered and accept a position with us during the application process, we will store the personal data collected as part of the application process for at least the duration of your employment.</p> <p><strong>Disclosure of data to third parties</strong></p> <p>Data transmitted as part of your application will be transferred using TLS encryption and stored in a database. This database is operated by Greenhouse, which offers a human resource and applicant management software solution (https://www.greenhouse.com/data-processing-addendum). In this context, Greenhouse is our processor under article 28 of the GDPR. In this case, the processing is based on an agreement for the processing of orders between us as the controller and Greenhouse.</p> <p><strong>Rights of data subjects</strong></p> <p>If we as the controller process personal data, you as the data subject have certain rights under Chapter III of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), depending on the legal basis and the purpose of the processing, in particular the right of access (article 15 of the GDPR) and the rights to rectification (article 16 of the GDPR), erasure (article 17 of the GDPR), restriction of processing (article 18 of the GDPR), and data portability (article 20 of the GDPR), as well as the right to object (article 21 of the GDPR). If the personal data is processed with your consent, you have the right to withdraw this consent under article 7 III of the GDPR.</p> <p>To assert your rights as a data subject in relation to the data processed during this online application process, please refer to our Data Protection Officer (see item 2).</p> <p><strong>Concluding provisions</strong></p> <p>We reserve the right to adjust this data privacy statement at any point in time to ensure that it is in line with the current legal requirements at all times, or in order to accommodate changes in the application process or other processes. In this case, the new data privacy statement applies to any later visit of this recruitment website or any later job application.<br><br></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>LEGAL NOTICE</strong></span></p> <h3>1. Information according to § 5 DDG</h3> <p>SKD SE<br>Französische Str. 12<br>10117 Berlin</p> <p><br>Internet: <a href="https://stark-defence.com/en/">www.stark-defence.com<br></a>E-Mail: ----- <p>SKD SE, Berlin (registered office of the company), is a Societas Europaea (legal form for joint stock companies), registered at the district court of Berlin (Charlottenburg) under the register number: HRB 260878 B, represented by the Executive Board: Uwe Horstmann, Dr. André Schneider, Johannes Schaback, Jan-Patrick Helmsen, Martin Rost.</p> <p>Chairman of the Supervisory Board is Mr. Robert Maier.</p> <p>VAT ID No.: DE369778559</p> <h3>2. Liability</h3> <p>We are responsible for the content of our website in accordance with the provisions of general law. All content is created with the necessary care and to the best of our knowledge and is for information purposes only. Insofar as we refer on our Internet pages to the Internet pages of third parties by means of hyperlinks, we cannot accept any liability for guarantee that the linked content is always up to date, correct and complete, as this content is outside our responsibility and we have no influence on its future design. If, in your opinion, content violates applicable law or is inappropriate, please let us know. The legal information on this page as well as all questions and disputes in connection with the design of this website are subject to the law of the Federal Republic of Germany.</p> <h3>3. Data Protection</h3> <p>You can find our data protection information here. There you will also find the contact details of our data protection officer.</p> <h3>4. Copyright Information</h3> <p>The texts, images, photos, videos and graphics on our website are generally protected by copyright. Any unauthorized use (in particular the reproduction, editing or distribution) of this copyright-protected content is therefore prohibited. If you intend to use this content or parts thereof, please contact us in advance using the details above. If we are not ourselves the owner of the required copyright usage rights, we will endeavor to arrange contact with the entitled party.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.descriptionText: <p>FEQ128R103</p> <p>Look at all the apps you have on your mobile. Many of these are built by customers that are within our Digital Natives and Startup patch and are using Databricks to support their business.</p> <p>We aim to inspire our customers to make informed decisions that push their business forward. We provide a user-friendly and intuitive platform that makes it easy to turn insights into action and foster a culture of creativity, experimentation, and continuous improvement. You will be an essential part of this mission, using your technical expertise to demonstrate how our Data Intelligence Platform can help customers solve their complex data challenges.&nbsp;</p> <p>At Databricks, our core principles are at the heart of everything we do; creating a culture of proactiveness and a customer-centric mindset guides us to create a unified platform that makes data science and analytics accessible to everyone. You'll work with a collaborative, customer-focused team that values innovation and creativity, using your skills to create customized solutions to help our customers achieve their goals and guide their businesses forward.&nbsp;</p> <p>Join us in our quest to change how people work with data and make a better world!</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Form successful relationships with clients throughout your assigned territory, providing technical and business value to Databricks customers in collaboration with Account Executives.</li> <li>Gain excitement from clients about Databricks through hands-on evaluation and programming, integrating with the wider cloud ecosystem and 3rd party applications.</li> <li>You will develop into a ‘champion’ and trusted advisor on multiple issues of architecture, design, and implementation to lead to the successful adoption of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.</li> <li>Contribute to building the Databricks technical community through engagement at workshops, seminars, and meet-ups.</li> <li>Support your customers by authoring reference architectures, how-tos, and demo applications.</li> <li>Grow your knowledge and expertise to the level of a technical and/or industry specialist.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engage customers in technical sales, challenge their questions, guide clear outcomes, and communicate technical and value propositions</li> <li>Structured approach in working and guiding your customers</li> <li>Develop and maintain customer relationships and build internal partnerships with account executives and teams</li> <li>Prior experience with coding in a core programming language (i.e., Python, SQL, Java) and willingness to learn a base level of Spark.</li> <li>Proficient with Big Data Analytics technologies, including hands-on expertise with complex proofs-of-concept and public cloud platform(s)&nbsp;</li> <li>Experienced in use case discovery, scoping, and delivering complex solution architecture designs to multiple audiences requiring an ability to context switch in levels of technical depth</li> <li>Minimum of 7 years of experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, or related customer-facing technical roles</li> </ul> <p><strong>Notes on mandatory requirements:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Pre-Sales experience&nbsp;</li> <li>The location for the role must be in the Munich or Berlin region (or within a commutable distance for a hybrid schedule).</li> <li>Fluency in German and English is required as a minimum.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior IT Engineer
jobs.descriptionText: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3> <p>Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.</p></div><h3 data-pm-slice="1 3 []">About the role</h3> <p>At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human.</p> <p>We're looking for a<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><strong>Senior IT Engineer</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working.</p> <p>This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates.</p> <p>You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes.</p> <p>Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <p><strong>Own and improve our IT operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution.</li> <li>Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems.</li> <li>Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management.</li> <li>Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience.</li> <li>Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build smarter systems through AI and automation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT.</li> <li>Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency.</li> <li>Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes.</li> <li>Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work.</li> <li>Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Think like a product owner</strong></p> <ul> <li>Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements.</li> <li>Work with stakeholders to jobs.title: Head of Operations (GPU Fleet)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your mission

Demand for sovereign European compute is not our constraint. Capacity is. As Head of Operations you own Lyceum's GPU fleet end to end: every GPU we own, lease or operate for partners, from the first conversation with a data center to the day a node goes live and every day it runs after that.

The job has two halves. Grow the fleet: turn new financing into live GPUs, fast. Run the fleet: keep everything we operate available, efficient and under contract. Your north star is GPUs under management. You report directly to the CEO and work closely with the CFO, CTO and engineering. Depending on experience, we hire this role at Head or VP level.

What You'll Do

  • Secure data center capacity across Europe: power, liquid cooling, space, connectivity and colocation leases

  • Own relationships with OEMs and suppliers for servers, networking and storage, and manage lead times so hardware arrives when we need it

  • Run every deployment as a programme, from logistics and installation to burn-in, acceptance and handover to engineering

  • Keep the financing side of deployments clean: schedules, drawdown milestones, asset records, insurance and lender reporting

  • Run the live fleet together with engineering: availability, incidents, RMAs, warranty, spares and remote hands

  • Own supply-side contracts, renewals and SLAs, and drive down cost per GPU-hour

  • Build the operations team and the operating rhythm that lets us scale deployments without scaling chaos

 

Your profile

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of bringing physical infrastructure online at scale, ideally data centers, GPU or HPC clusters, or comparable hardware-heavy environments

  • You have owned the whole picture, from capacity and suppliers to deployment and live operations, not one slice of it

  • Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking. You see the whole board, from site selection to unit economics

  • Enough technical depth to hold your own with engineers and vendors on power, cooling, networking and hardware

  • Strong programme management: you run complex projects with many parties against hard deadlines

  • Confidence negotiating and managing contracts with data centers, OEMs and suppliers

  • You have built and led teams from scratch and still go deep into the details yourself

  • Very high sense of urgency and ownership

  • You make good decisions fast with incomplete information and prefer momentum over perfection

  • Strong written and verbal communication in English, German is a plus. Willingness to travel across Europe

Why us?

  • Outstanding team: Work with some of the best engineers in the world, coming from hedge funds, big tech, AI startups and top universities

  • Once in a lifetime opportunity: Early-stage company in the fastest-growing market in the world

  • Ownership: Shape how European AI companies access GPU compute

  • European mission: Build sovereign, GDPR-compliant AI infrastructure for the next generation of deep-tech

jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. Powered by advanced AI, first-party data, and world-class engineering, we connect app developers to over 600 million users worldwide. From our global leadership in rewarded advertising with Playtime to breaking ground in programmatic adtech with adjoe Ads, we build high-performance mobile infrastructure that redefines how users discover and engage with apps.

Where Milliseconds Power Global Programmatic Scale

The Programmatic Solutions team powers adjoe’s real-time ad network solution, directly integrated with leading mobile mediation platforms across the ecosystem. At our core is a smart bidder leveraging machine learning to predict conversion probability and lifetime value in real time, serving the right ad at the exact right moment.

The team owns the complete lifecycle of our programmatic ad engine on mobile: from our native iOS and Android SDKs that seamlessly render ad creatives and stream granular telemetry events back to our servers, to the developer-facing APIs and dashboards that give publishers total visibility into monetization performance. Because our code executes live inside third-party apps alongside major mediation stacks, every millisecond saved directly impacts revenue, fill rate, and user experience.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Swift expert with deep SDK experience: You bring 8+ years of mobile development experience with a strong focus on modern Swift, alongside proven experience architecting, building, and maintaining production iOS libraries/SDKs. You know how to design clean, backward-compatible public APIs and package robust binaries (XCFrameworks) that thousands of external publishers can integrate with zero friction.

  • High-performance rendering & creative UI/UX: You will build and optimize the visual components of adjoe Ads—innovative ad formats, dynamic video players, and rich web views seen by millions of users daily. Leveraging UIKit, AVFoundation, and WKWebView, you know how to build fluid, native-feeling experiences, introduce A/B testable UI features, and diagnose frame drops or memory leaks using Xcode Instruments.

  • Mediation integration & AdTech standards: You will ensure our SDK seamlessly interfaces with leading mobile mediation platforms and ad servers. You take ownership of aligning our mobile stack with IAB specifications and advertising industry standards, ensuring reliable impression tracking, viewability measurement, and attribution.

  • Build automation & developer-facing distribution: You contribute to and maintain our CI/CD pipelines to guarantee flawless, automated releases. You have hands-on experience with modern dependency managers and build automation tools (Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods, fastlane, and GitLab CI) to package, test, and distribute lightweight mobile artifacts.

  • Observability & technical stability: You don't just write code; you safeguard its execution in the wild. You will expand our monitoring and crash-reporting frameworks to proactively catch anomalies, optimize memory and CPU footprint, and ensure zero instability across diverse iOS versions and device generations.

  • Plus – Cross-platform & multi-stack exposure: Basic working knowledge of Objective-C is a strong advantage. Experience with cross-platform frameworks (React Native, Flutter, Unity) or parallel Android development experience is highly valued to support our broader mobile ecosystem.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets; you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 600M+ users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries who learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

jobs.title: Remote Sr. Product Manager - Revenue Management - 1 year contract (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

As Senior Product Manager for one of our Revenue Management teams at RoomPriceGenie, you'll own the experience where hoteliers see, trust and act on our AI-powered pricing, both in our app and embedded in our partners' PMSs through Revenue Intelligence. This is not a feature-delivery role. We're looking for a senior PM who sets the strategy and direction, makes hard trade-offs, and turns complex pricing logic into decisions a hotelier can make in seconds.

You'll lead a team of engineers, collaborate closely with design and research and work closely with leadership, Account Management, Integrations, Customer Success and Sales. Your mission: make RoomPriceGenie the pricing tool thousands of independent hotels rely on every day.

What you'll do

Product Vision & Strategy

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area, anchored in clear business goals: adoption, retention, revenue uplift and expansion.

  • Decide what not to build, and bring stakeholders along on why.

  • Shape how pricing shows up across surfaces, from our core app to partner integrations and multi-property accounts.

  • Champion simplicity and explainability: hoteliers should understand why a price was recommended and feel confident acting on it.

Discovery & Delivery

  • Talk to hoteliers regularly and, with UX research, turn hidden friction in their revenue management workflows into strategy, not just backlog items.

  • Work closely with the other RM team to turn forecasting and pricing model output into clear experiences that build trust and drive action.

  • Drive solutions end to end, from opportunity assessment to measured impact, knowing when to move fast and when to dig deeper.

Impact & Influence

  • Define and own KPIs for your area, be clear about what moved them and why, and be honest about correlation vs. causation.

  • Influence across teams without authority, especially where your area depends on other RM teams, Reporting and Integrations.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years as a Senior Product Manager, ideally in B2B SaaS, with clear ownership of outcomes, not just outputs.

  • A track record of making complex systems radically simple

  • Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguous spaces and making trade-offs with incomplete information.

  • Genuine excitement about how AI is reshaping software and how it´s build.

  • Plus: Experience in hospitality tech, revenue management systems or pricing.

  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.

  • You're a curious, structured thinker with strong product intuition.

  • You can say no to a stakeholder and keep the relationship intact.

  • You ask "why" until it's clear, and explain "how" until it clicks.

  • You reflect honestly on what didn't work.

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

  • Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

  • Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

  • BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.💛🧠

We kindly ask that recruitment agencies refrain from reaching out regarding this vacancy. Thank you for your understanding.

Compensation: €100K – €120K

  • • €100K – €120K

jobs.title: Staff Engineer | Voyagu
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role: Staff Engineer (Integrations / Supply, air travel)

Company: Voyagu

Location: Fully remote, Europe preferred. European time zone; about two hours of difference is fine. About eight hours online, and some overlap with US time zones helps because many users are there.

Job Type: Full-time. Contract model is flexible: contractor, payroll provider or direct employment.

About Voyagu

Voyagu builds one platform that runs several travel businesses. Today the focus is air travel. The platform covers client management (CRM), ERP modules for finance and accounting, travel operations, and integrations with travel supply systems.

The model is offline travel: agencies that sell through people. Voyagu does not sell the software and does not plan to, but agencies work with it in different models. It is a bootstrap scaleup, so teams are lean and money is counted.

Development leans heavily on AI. Teams of AI agents run big features under a business operator and a technical operator. Sometimes this turns two half-years of work into two weeks. It does not always work. When code is cheap, product vision and architecture become the bottleneck, and that is where you come in.

This role owns the integrations and supply direction. Air travel alone is deep: every airline has its own distribution channels and APIs. You would lead one of five platform development streams and report to the CTO. There is no product manager in between, and you work directly with the founder and other business stakeholders. The team has no one with your profile today, so you would be the first.

What you are expected to do

Technical ownership

  • Lead the integrations and supply direction as its technical owner.

  • Build integrations with GDS systems. Voyagu works with one today and needs more.

  • Connect airline direct APIs and non-GDS protocols across multiple sources.

  • Handle servicing after sale: changes, cancellations, refunds, and group bookings split into parts.

  • Work with live, real-time availability. Seat availability does not depend on price.

  • Prevent costly errors. One missed booking can mean tens of thousands of dollars. Design for reliability, for example with idempotency, so nothing is paid or bought twice.

  • Keep the solution sized to Voyagu’s scale and avoid over-design. This is not internet-scale work.

  • Keep the system stable. Speed and error rate are the measures.

Vision and delivery

  • Shape the technical vision with stakeholders and defend it. They will challenge it.

  • Expect no ready-made tasks. Business stakeholders give you a direction, not a finished task.

  • Turn the agreed platform capabilities into features and give estimates. Several dozen capabilities are written down, such as search and booking.

  • Success means Voyagu accepts your estimates and you deliver them, or come close. Part of the plan will be agreed together with you.

AI-driven development

  • Build and direct teams of AI coding agents instead of writing code by hand.

  • Explain and defend how to use AI effectively.

  • Bring AI practices that are as good as Voyagu’s, or better.

Team

  • Lead the two people already working in this direction, once you have onboarded.

  • Hire as little as possible. Hiring is a last resort. Long term the direction may grow to one to three people.

What you need to succeed

  • You have worked in the travel domain, especially on integrations with supply systems. About two or more years is likely enough.

  • You understand booking versus ticket, and the statuses and states of each.

  • You have owned a large piece of a product, not a small slice.

  • You work at staff or senior level, as architect and technical lead.

  • You understand what Voyagu does and why, and you talk well with stakeholders.

  • You use AI well beyond the beginner level and have a clear view on how to use it effectively.

  • You believe small teams work. You do not think in big organisations.

  • You work in a European time zone; ideally you are based in Europe.

  • You speak Russian: engineering works mostly in Russian. Business teams speak English, and English B2 is enough.

  • Nice to have: you have seen both corporate and lean startup worlds, or a bootstrap scaleup. You may be an ex-founder or a small-company CTO who stayed hands-on.

  • Nice to have: you have run teams of agents, not only asked an agent to write a feature.

  • Nice to have: vendor-side experience building for end users. Python is the current main stack, but language skill is not important.

  • Not required: high-load experience, writing agent skills, or deep C#/legacy aviation knowledge.

What you get

  • You own a whole direction, with responsibility handed over fully.

  • You are the technical lead for integrations and supply, with no product-manager layer in between.

  • You work with AI agent teams. Voyagu will invest heavily in tokens and compute where it pays off.

jobs.title: Recruitment Partner
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

hirehire agency is built around deep product and design expertise. Our expert network is made up of senior designers and PMs who have worked at companies like Intercom, Stripe, Revolut, and others. They interview and evaluate like practitioners – because they’ve done the job. That’s what sets us apart from the typical agency.

Our clients include JetBrains, Replika, Recraft, Sentry, Toloka, Nebius, White Circle, Manychat, Capital.com, TripleTen, Pleo, Emerging Travel Group, Solidroad, and others.

What’s at our core

Three pillars everything revolves around:

  • Clients – they need the right person, fast.

  • Experts – they evaluate candidates with a practitioner’s eye.

  • Talent – people with their own goals and pace, not a line on a resume.

A Recruiting Partner holds all three at once: hearing the client’s request, listening to the candidate, guiding and supporting the expert. This is deep, partner-like work with people – like leading a dance, everyone moving in the same direction.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own each search end-to-end – from brief to offer, including timelines, quality, and communication. Interviews are run by our experts.

  • Be the main point of contact for clients, candidates, and experts, building long-term, trust-based relationships with candidates rather than transactional touchpoints.

  • Work with top-tier talent – we focus on the top 1% of candidates, and that bar shapes how we engage with people from the very first conversation.

  • Write sharp, un-templated job descriptions, briefs, and outreach.

  • Manage sourcing through our internal network plus targeted external search, powered by AI.

  • Track progress with data and feedback, not just gut feel.

  • Bring structure that raises quality across the team.

  • Help build the AI tools the whole team relies on.

What you need to succeed

  • 3+ years of recruiting experience, ideally in fast-paced tech environments.

  • We're built for AI-native hiring, and we work the same way ourselves. We want someone who actually builds AI into their daily workflow.

  • Confidence with ATSs, outreach platforms, and HR tech in general – plus curiosity about what's new.

  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset – you keep things moving.

  • Empathy and the ability to support people without losing pace.

Really, really nice to have

  • Experience hiring designers across seniority levels – or hands-on design experience yourself.

What you get

  • A stable base salary, plus a commission on every role you help fill.

  • Fully remote work and flexible hours; CET ± a few hours works fine.

  • Unconventional projects with global reach.

  • Early access to new recruiting tech.

  • Growth in skill and earnings, tied to the results you bring in.

  • Direct mentorship from the co-founders.

  • An environment that’s genuinely open and just as genuinely demanding – support and a high bar reinforce each other here.

jobs.title: Langfuse - Senior Cloud Infra Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Cloud Infrastructure at Langfuse

Your work will keep Langfuse running — everywhere.

Langfuse processes over a billion trace events per month. When a Fortune 50 company relies on Langfuse in production, they're relying on the infrastructure you operate. You'll own uptime, performance, and cost efficiency across our entire cloud footprint — and you'll make sure every self-hosted deployment runs just as smoothly.

You'll operate Langfuse Cloud on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud, with Datadog as the observability backbone. You'll also own our public self-hosted infrastructure — including our Helm chart, Docker Compose setup, and everything in between — so that teams from startups to enterprises can run Langfuse on their own terms.

This isn't a "maintain what exists" role. We're scaling fast, and you'll be the person who makes sure the infrastructure grows ahead of demand — not behind it.

Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the team behind the database at the core of our stack is one channel away. Few infrastructure roles give you that kind of direct access to the people who build your most critical dependency.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

Own Langfuse Cloud operations: You'll run our production environments on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud. You'll manage deployments, autoscaling, capacity planning, and cost optimization — making sure we stay fast and affordable as traffic scales.

Build world-class observability: You'll own our Datadog setup end to end — dashboards, alerts, and SLOs. When something degrades, you'll ensure we know before our customers do. You'll build the monitoring culture that lets the whole team ship with confidence.

Make self-hosting effortless: Thousands of teams run Langfuse on their own infrastructure. You'll own and evolve our Helm chart, Docker Compose configuration, and deployment documentation. You'll turn "works on my machine" into "works on every machine" — from a single-node setup to a multi-region enterprise deployment.

Automate everything: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, automated scaling, zero-downtime deployments. You'll replace manual processes with automation that makes the team faster and the platform more reliable.

Scale for what's next: We're growing fast and new product directions — like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation — push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale and building the foundation before we get there. 10x is always just one quarter away here at Langfuse.

Harden security and compliance: As more enterprises adopt Langfuse, you'll help ensure our cloud and self-hosted deployments meet the security and compliance bar that large organizations require.

 

What we're looking for

  • Strong infrastructure or SRE engineer who gets excited about running systems at scale and making them better every day

  • Experience operating production workloads on AWS (ECS/Fargate, networking, IAM, S3, etc.) or on comparable hyperscale vendors.

  • Comfortable with container orchestration — Kubernetes and/or ECS, Helm charts, Docker

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or similar)

  • Strong monitoring and observability instincts — you've built dashboards and alerts that actually caught problems (Datadog experience is a plus)

  • You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about reliability, automation, and how to ship infrastructure changes safely

  • Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment helping users debug their self-hosted deployments

  • Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

  • CS or quantitative degree preferred

Bonus points:

  • Experience with ClickHouse Cloud or other managed analytical databases

  • Background in operating high-throughput event processing or observability infrastructure

  • Contributions to open source infrastructure tooling (Helm charts, Terraform modules, etc.)

  • Former founder

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

Compensation: €90K – €160K • Offers Equity

  • • Salary €90K – €160K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
This role can be office-based in Freiburg (Germany) / San Francisco (USA) or hybrid with a requirement to be in one of the offices one full week per month.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

Why this role

Black Forest Labs builds visual intelligence: models that create and understand images and video, and increasingly act in the physical world. For a company whose work is visual, the brand is part of the work. It's often the first thing people see of us, before they've tried a single model. It has to hold the same bar as our models and grow as they do.

We're hiring our first Brand Designer to define that brand and own it wherever people meet BFL. You'll bring the taste that sets the standard for how BFL looks, and build what keeps it consistent across launches, the website, events and everything in between.

This is a hands-on lead role. You'll ship much of the work yourself while setting up the tools and processes that let others ship at your level. Over time, you'll also shape how brand and marketing design grows at BFL, including who we hire next.

What you'll work on

  • Lead how our visual identity grows, including logo, type, color, imagery and motion, and turn it into guidelines and design systems others can work from.

  • Create the concept and creative direction for each model launch, campaign and event, working with research to show what every new model can do.

  • Make the work people see every day, online and offline: social posts, editorial, decks, docs, sales material, event spaces, merchandise and print.

  • Own the direction of bfl.ai and our growth pages, and help make the website one of the clearest and strongest expressions of the brand.

  • Build templates, internal tools and an agent-readable design system so marketing, sales and engineering can create on-brand work themselves. We'd rather you build the generator than draw the hundredth asset.

  • Work with product design on shared foundations like type, color and components, so bfl.ai, the Playground, the dashboard, and other product surfaces feel like one company.

Your team

Design at BFL is young, and much of how it works is still open, including how we review work, what we call finished and how design informs decisions across teams. You'll help define these and represent design across the company.

You'll work closely with Devran, who leads design at BFL, and with teams across the company, including marketing, growth, developer relations, research and product design. Among the people you'll work with most are Owais and Aitana in marketing and Jay in growth engineering.

What we're looking for

  • At least six years designing brands, and one or two projects you'd still stand behind today, where you played a key role from concept through rollout and others now build on the work. We're looking for an original idea, clear taste and execution that holds up in every detail.

  • Deep craft in identity and visual design, from typography and color to layout, art direction and motion. You notice the crop, the spacing and the timing of a transition, and you fix them before anyone asks.

  • A quality bar that raises the work around you. You've made a team better before, through the work you shipped and the feedback you gave.

  • You're ready to ship from day one. You've started work no one asked for, seen it through, and sorted out disagreements directly with the people involved.

  • A systems thinker. You've built guidelines, templates or design systems that others used well without you in the room, and you can tell when work should scale and when it should stay one of a kind.

  • You move easily between the big picture and the details. You can make the case for a design decision to a founder, an engineer and a marketer, and you change how you make it for each of them.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. One week might take you from a model launch to merch to a new page on bfl.ai. Much here isn't figured out yet, and you see that as an opportunity.

  • Curiosity about new tools, new problems and getting better at your craft. You can point to something you taught yourself recently and how it changed your work.

Nice to have:

  • Shipping web pages or prototypes yourself with AI coding tools such as Claude Code.

  • Building your own tools for brand work, such as template generators or small internal apps.

  • Using generative image or video models in your creative process.

  • Motion, 3D or creative coding.

  • Experience at an AI lab.

How we work together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe or the US and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg or San Francisco to stay connected with the team.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

Please apply even if you don't match every line above. What matters most to us is curiosity and a love of making things. You don't need to know every tool we use. We'd rather hire a great, curious designer than someone who ticks every box.

If this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation

EU : €148K - €175K + equity
SF : $219K - $265K + equity

jobs.title: Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer to help us in our mission by taking technical ownership of the electrical test equipment and automated functional tests required to verify our spacecraft, engineering models and test beds, to ensure that our mission will succeed and our system will work in space!

Key Responsibilities

In your role as a Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer, your role will include the following responsibilities:

  • Take technical ownership of electrical test equipment and functional-test capability for flight hardware, engineering models and test beds, from early definition through delivery, use and maintenance

  • Establish and maintain a practical development and readiness plan so that test equipment and software are available for early engineering-model testing and subsequent flight-hardware testing

  • Define and assess electrical test-equipment and functional-test needs, making requirements, interfaces, safety constraints, risks and dependencies visible and driving their resolution

  • Translate system and subsystem requirements into complete, traceable functional-test strategies, procedures, sequences and objective pass/fail criteria

  • Lead the electrical design, integration, build, troubleshooting and maintenance of test equipment and its software, including power, signal, communication and measurement interfaces

  • Develop and review automated functional-test software, data acquisition and test sequences in LabVIEW and/or VeriStand, with clear interlocks, limit checks, safe-stop behaviour and maintainable test records

  • Define and review test-equipment architecture, instrumentation, cabling, schematics, interface definitions, configuration and verification evidence

  • Plan and support test readiness reviews, ensuring that hardware, test equipment, software, procedures, safety controls and acceptance criteria are fit for use before testing begins

  • Support and perform unit-, subsystem- and system-level electrical and functional tests on engineering and flight hardware, including hands-on test preparation and execution

  • Lead technical investigation of test anomalies, assess test data, distinguish unit-under-test issues from test-system issues, and support non-conformance disposition, retest and closure

  • Coordinate electrical test activities and technical interfaces with MAIT, design, systems, software, quality and other relevant teams

  • Provide technical guidance and review to other engineers and technicians, sharing good practice in test design, execution, troubleshooting and evidence capture

  • Manufacture and assemble test-equipment components where required

  • Participate in environmental tests and launch campaigns.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Senior MAIT Electrical and Test Engineer, ideally you will bring the following skillset, mentality and experience:

  • Degree in aerospace engineering, electrical engineering or comparable qualification

  • Significant hands-on experience with electrical/electronic components and systems, ideally in spacecraft AIT or functional verification

  • Demonstrated ability to independently plan and deliver electrical or functional tests for complex hardware, from requirements and interfaces through test execution and evidence review

  • Strong practical experience developing functional tests from requirements, including test strategy, procedures, acceptance criteria, traceability and test-data review

  • Theoretical understanding as well as practical experience with electrical test equipment and test interfaces:

    • Electrical design and integration of test equipment, including instrumentation, cabling, connectors, and power and signal interfaces

    • Physical assembly and commissioning of test equipment (building racks, routing cables, etc.)

    • Familiarity with network configuration and network protocols (TCP/IP) used by test systems

  • Ability to develop and review software for test equipment and automated functional tests in LabVIEW and/or VeriStand; experience with Python or similar is an asset

  • Experience with data acquisition, test automation, measurement-chain verification and systematic troubleshooting on electrical test equipment

  • Experience preparing hardware and test systems for controlled testing, including safety controls, configuration management and objective test records

  • Ability to lead technical anomaly investigations, communicate uncertainty and risk, and agree evidence-based retest or closure actions

  • Experience providing technical guidance, reviewing work or sharing good practice with colleagues

  • Exposure to Mission Control Software platforms like CCS5, COSMOS or similar; experience with COSMOS is a plus

  • Experience with communication and power test equipment is an asset

  • Ability to read, understand and apply technical manuals, data reports, electrical schematics and design specifications

  • Willingness to work hands-on with flight hardware

  • Joy in embracing technical problems and the process of solving them

  • Sense of responsibility and a clean and organized way of working

  • Fuent in written and spoken English

  • Willingness to travel worldwide for test and launch campaigns.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

jobs.title: AIT Electrical/Harness Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a hands-on AIT Electrical/Harness Technician to help us in our mission by building, integrating, maintaining and documenting Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) and electrical harnesses used for FM1 integration and on-site ground testing, to ensure that our mission will succeed and our system will work in space!

Key Responsibilities

In your role as an AIT Electrical/Harness Technician, your role will include the following responsibilities:

  • Build, wire, assemble and inspect EGSE assemblies and associated electrical harnesses in accordance with released drawings, bills of materials and work instructions

  • Where drawings or complete work instructions are unavailable, use available information and agreed engineering direction to support practical build decisions, capture the as-built configuration and any assumptions or open points, and seek review and approval before the equipment is used

  • Manufacture, terminate, label, route, inspect and maintain electrical harnesses and test cables used during FM1 integration and ground testing

  • Perform prescribed electrical checks, such as continuity, pinout and polarity checks, using approved procedures, equipment and acceptance limits

  • Support installation, setup, connection, disconnection and removal of EGSE and harnesses in integration areas and at on-site ground-test locations

  • Maintain and troubleshoot EGSE, harnesses and test cables; identify faults and report discrepancies for engineering or quality disposition before making changes outside approved instructions

  • Support engineers and test teams during integration and ground-test activities by preparing equipment, maintaining tidy cable routing and assisting with approved checks

  • Maintain accurate build, inspection, test, maintenance and as-built records, including equipment identification and configuration status

  • Keep track of tools and measuring equipment used for the work, including their serviceability and calibration status where applicable

  • Follow applicable electrical-safety, ESD, clean-work-area and hardware-handling requirements

  • Support the packing, transport, deployment and return of EGSE and harnesses for ground-test campaigns

  • Help maintain an orderly workshop, equipment inventory and stock of consumables.


What we would love to see from you

In the role of AIT Electrical/Harness Technician, ideally you will bring the following skillset, mentality and experience:

  • Vocational training or apprenticeship in electrical/electronic engineering, electronics, mechatronics or a comparable qualification; equivalent practical experience will also be considered

  • Hands-on experience assembling electrical wiring, cable harnesses, electrical panels or rack-based equipment; experience in aerospace AIT or with EGSE is an asset

  • Practical skills in wire preparation, crimping, connector termination, cable routing and labelling; soldering experience is an asset where required by the work instructions

  • Ability to read and follow electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, connector pinouts, assembly drawings and work instructions

  • Experience using hand tools and basic electrical measurement equipment, such as a multimeter or continuity tester

  • Careful approach to workmanship, inspection, configuration control and recording completed work

  • Willingness to stop and raise a discrepancy when a drawing, label, measurement or instruction does not agree, rather than making an unauthorised change

  • Basic fault-finding skills and the ability to communicate findings clearly to engineers and test teams

  • Willingness to work hands-on in workshops, integration areas and on-site test locations, including supporting time-critical campaign activities

  • Sense of responsibility and a clean, organized and safety-conscious way of working

  • Fluent in written and spoken English

  • Willingness to travel for ground-test and launch campaigns.

 

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. jobs.title: Contract manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

The Exploration Company builds complex space systems under contracts with government and institutional customers. Programs of this kind evolve: requirements change, design maturity improves, schedules shift, and suppliers and customers request adjustments. Each change must be formally proposed, assessed, negotiated, and recorded in the contract before it can be executed and paid for.

As Contract Manager, you will own the change lifecycle for your assigned contracts. You will drive Contract Change Notices (CCNs) from initial request to signature, protect the company's position on scope, cost, and schedule, and keep the contract baseline accurate for the program team.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the CCN lifecycle from receipt or initiation through impact assessment, negotiation, approval, and formal issue, with clear ownership and deadlines for every open item.

  • Chase and track open CCNs with customer contracting officers, program managers, and internal stakeholders, and escalate delays that threaten schedule or cash flow.

  • Coordinate impact assessments with engineering, quality, supply chain, and finance, covering technical scope, cost, schedule, risk, and compliance effects.

  • Prepare and negotiate change proposals, including pricing justification, supporting documentation, and changes to terms and conditions.

  • Maintain the contract baseline by recording each approved CCN in the contract register and ensuring the scope, price, milestones, and deliverables reflect the current agreed position.

  • Monitor entitlement and notice obligations, including time limits for submitting change requests and claims under the contract and applicable procurement rules.

  • Manage the CCN register and reporting, providing regular status updates on open, pending, and approved changes, value at stake, and aging to program leadership.

  • Support invoicing and revenue recognition by ensuring approved changes are reflected in billing milestones and Odoo or ERP records.

  • Ensure compliance with the contract's terms, applicable public procurement and export-control rules, and internal approval and delegation-of-authority policies.

  • Prepare for audits and reviews by maintaining a complete, traceable record of change decisions and correspondence.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

jobs.title: Nyx PMO
jobs.location: Munich, Germany; Bordeaux, France; or Turin, Italy
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

As we continue to develop the Nyx vehicle and prepare its future missions, strong program coordination is essential. We are looking for a motivated and structured Nyx PMO to support the Chief Program Manager and the Project Management teams in preparing, integrating and tracking schedules across our international organisation.

Your Mission

As a member of the Nyx Program Management Office, you will support the preparation and integration of project schedules and help maintain reliable, up-to-date program data. You will work closely with Project Managers and teams across Munich, Bordeaux and Turin to ensure that planning information is collected, structured and available for effective programme decision-making.

This is a junior position offering broad exposure to program management, project planning and the development of a complex space vehicle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the preparation and integration of Nyx project and program schedules.

  • Collect schedule inputs from project managers and consolidate them into coherent planning views.

  • Maintain schedule data, activity progress, milestones, dependencies and tracking information up to date.

  • Follow up with stakeholders to obtain status updates and clarify missing or inconsistent information.

  • Support Project Managers in the preparation, review and maintenance of their schedules.

  • Support the use of scheduling and project-management tools across the Nyx program.

  • Prepare schedule updates, progress overviews and inputs for program reviews.

  • Help identify schedule risks, delays, dependencies and conflicts, and raise them to the relevant stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of PMO processes, templates and reporting routines.

  • Support the consistent application of planning practices across the different Nyx locations.

What You Bring

  • First experience in project management, program management, PMO, planning, engineering coordination or a similar environment.

  • A degree or equivalent experience in engineering, business, project management or a related field.

  • A structured and detail-oriented approach to work.

  • Good working knowledge of spreadsheets and a willingness to learn scheduling and project-management tools.

  • The ability to collect, organise and communicate information clearly.

  • A proactive mindset and the confidence to follow up with stakeholders across different teams.

  • The ability to identify inconsistencies, raise risks early and support the resolution of planning issues.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in an international and cross-functional environment.

  • A genuine interest in space exploration and complex technical programmes.

  • Professional fluency in English. Additional languages are a plus.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.
